local Fling = {Active=false, busy=false, allRun=0}
local function stopFling() Fling.Active=false end

do local __ok,__err=pcall(function()

function Fling.run(target)
    if not target then return end
    if Fling.busy then
        Fling.Active = false
        for _ = 1, 40 do if not Fling.busy then break end task.wait(0.05) end
    end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local tChar = target.Character
    local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (myRoot and myHum and tRoot) or myHum.Health <= 0 then
        Library:Notify({Title="fling", Text="target has no character", Duration=2})
        return
    end

    Fling.busy = true; Fling.Active = true
    local finished = false
    task.spawn(function()
        -- classic fling: your own character flies to the target, spins on them and the contact
        -- impulse launches them. no clones, no hiding, no camera tricks, no standing still.
        local okF, errF = pcall(function()
            local startPos = tRoot.Position
            local lastSafe = startPos
            local oldFall = WS.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
            pcall(function() WS.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0 / 0 end)

            -- heavier parts = stronger contact impulse
            local pp = {}
            for _, pt in ipairs(myChar:GetDescendants()) do
                if pt:IsA("BasePart") then
                    pp[pt] = pt.CustomPhysicalProperties
                    pcall(function() pt.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(100, 0.3, 0.5) end)
                end
            end

            local rng = Random.new()
            local i, t0, launched = 0, tick(), false
            while Fling.Active and tick() - t0 < 4 do
                local tr = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local th = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local mr = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if LocalPlayer.Character ~= myChar or not tr or not mr or (th and th.Health <= 0) then break end
                local tv = tr.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
                if tv > 500 or (tr.Position - startPos).Magnitude > 60 then
                    launched = true
                    task.wait(0.35)  -- a few extra frames of contact while he flies off
                    break
                end
                lastSafe = tr.Position
                i = i + 1
                -- glue yourself onto the target every frame with a huge randomized velocity: the touch
                -- impulse is what actually throws him, so the contact has to stay inside his hitbox
                local off = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-0.4, 0.4), rng:NextNumber(0, 0.9), rng:NextNumber(-0.4, 0.4))
                mr.CFrame = CFrame.new(tr.Position + off + tr.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.03)
                mr.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-1, 1) * 9e7, 9e7 * 10, rng:NextNumber(-1, 1) * 9e7)
                mr.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end

            -- stop dead where the target was standing so you never fly off into the void yourself
            local t1 = tick()
            while tick() - t1 < 0.4 do
                local mr = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not mr then break end
                mr.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSafe)
                mr.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                mr.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end

            for pt, v in pairs(pp) do if pt.Parent then pcall(function() pt.CustomPhysicalProperties = v end) end end
            if LocalPlayer.Character == myChar and myHum.Parent then pcall(function() myHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end) end
            pcall(function() WS.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = oldFall end)

            if launched then
                Library:Notify({Title="fling", Text=target.Name .. " launched", Duration=2})
            end
        end)
        if not okF then warn("[piddle] fling error: " .. tostring(errF)) end
        Fling.Active = false; Fling.busy = false
        finished = true
    end)
    -- never hang the caller: wait at most 5.5s for the fling thread
    local t0 = tick()
    while not finished and tick() - t0 < 5.5 do task.wait(0.1) end
end

local function flingPlayer(target) task.spawn(Fling.run, target) end

function Fling.pointUnderMouse()
    local ok, m = pcall(function() return UIS:GetMouseLocation() end)
    if not ok or not m then return nil end
    local ray = Cam:ViewportPointToRay(m.X, m.Y)
    local dir = ray.Direction.Unit
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ex = {Cam}
    if LocalPlayer.Character then table.insert(ex, LocalPlayer.Character) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ex
    local hit = WS:Raycast(ray.Origin, dir * 1000, params)
    if hit and hit.Instance then
        local model = hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        while model do
            local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if plr and plr ~= LocalPlayer then return plr end
            model = model.Parent and model.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or nil
        end
    end

    local best, bestD
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local r = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if r then
                local rel = r.Position - ray.Origin
                local proj = rel:Dot(dir)
                if proj > 0 then
                    local off = (r.Position - (ray.Origin + dir * proj)).Magnitude
                    if off < 9 and (not bestD or proj < bestD) then best, bestD = p, proj end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end
function Fling.point()
    local p = Fling.pointUnderMouse()
    if p then flingPlayer(p)
    else Library:Notify({Title = "point fling", Text = "no player under the cursor", Duration = 2}) end
end

end)
if not __ok then warn("[piddle] module 'fling2' failed: "..tostring(__err)); pcall(function() Library:Notify({Title="piddle",Text="module 'fling2' failed: "..tostring(__err),Duration=10}) end) end end

X.Bang = {active = false, target = nil, track = nil}
function X.Bang.start(target)
    if not target or target == LocalPlayer then return end
    if not (target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
        Library:Notify({Title = "bang", Text = target.Name .. " has no character", Duration = 3})
        return
    end
    X.Bang.stop()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myRoot and myHum) or myHum.Health <= 0 then return end
    X.Bang.active = true
    X.Bang.target = target
    local track
    pcall(function()
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://189854234"
        track = myHum:LoadAnimation(anim)
        track:Play()
    end)
    X.Bang.track = track
    Library:Notify({Title = "bang", Text = "started on " .. target.Name .. " (press stop to end)", Duration = 3})
    task.spawn(function()
        while X.Bang.active and X.Bang.target == target and not Library.Unloaded do
            local tr = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local mr = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not tr or not mr then break end
            local forward = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.5)
            local backward = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.3)
            local ok1, t1 = pcall(function()
                local t = TweenService:Create(mr, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {CFrame = forward})
                t:Play(); t.Completed:Wait(); return t
            end)
            if not ok1 or not X.Bang.active or X.Bang.target ~= target then break end
            pcall(function()
                local t = TweenService:Create(mr, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {CFrame = backward})
                t:Play(); t.Completed:Wait()
            end)
        end
        if X.Bang.target == target then X.Bang.stop() end
    end)
end
function X.Bang.stop()
    X.Bang.active = false
    X.Bang.target = nil
    if X.Bang.track then pcall(function() X.Bang.track:Stop() end); X.Bang.track = nil end
end

-- JERK OFF: exact mechanic from the provided snippet - a handleless "Jerk Off" tool, equipping it
-- loops two animations by restarting them at a fixed TimePosition every frame; unequip stops all
X.Jerk = {speed = tonumber(getgenv().JERK_OFF_SPEED) or 1, tool = nil, conns = nil, s = false, on = false}
function X.Jerk.stopAnims()
    X.Jerk.s = false
    if X.Jerk.conns then
        for _, c in pairs(X.Jerk.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        X.Jerk.conns = nil
    end
end
function X.Jerk.makeTool()
    local t = Instance.new("Tool")
    t.Name = "Jerk Off"
    t.RequiresHandle = false
    t.CanBeDropped = false
    t.Parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    return t
end
function X.Jerk.bind(tool)
    Connect(tool.Equipped, function()
        X.Jerk.s = true
        if X.Jerk.conns then return end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        X.Jerk.conns = {}
        local function play(id, t1, t2, key)
            pcall(function()
                local a = Instance.new("Animation")
                a.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
                local tr = hum:LoadAnimation(a)
                X.Jerk.conns[key] = Connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
                    if X.Jerk.s then
                        if tr.TimePosition >= t2 or tr.IsPlaying == false then
                            tr:Play()
                            tr.TimePosition = t1
                            pcall(function() tr:AdjustSpeed(X.Jerk.speed) end)
                        end
                    else
                        tr:Stop()
                    end
                end)
                tr:Play()
                tr.TimePosition = t1
                pcall(function() tr:AdjustSpeed(X.Jerk.speed) end)
            end)
        end
        play("72042024", 0.5, 0.9, 1)
        play("168268306", 1, 1.001, 2)
    end)
    Connect(tool.Unequipped, function() X.Jerk.stopAnims() end)
end
function X.Jerk.setEnabled(v)
    X.Jerk.on = v and true or false
    if v then
        if not X.Jerk.tool or not X.Jerk.tool.Parent then
            X.Jerk.tool = X.Jerk.makeTool()
            X.Jerk.bind(X.Jerk.tool)
        end
        Library:Notify({Title = "jerk off", Text = "tool given - equip it to start", Duration = 3})
    else
        X.Jerk.stopAnims()
        if X.Jerk.tool then pcall(function() X.Jerk.tool:Destroy() end); X.Jerk.tool = nil end
        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = CFG.speed or 16; hum.JumpPower = CFG.jump or 50 end
    end
end
Connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
    X.Jerk.stopAnims()
    if X.Jerk.tool then pcall(function() X.Jerk.tool:Destroy() end); X.Jerk.tool = nil end
    if X.Jerk.on then
        task.wait(0.5)
        X.Jerk.tool = X.Jerk.makeTool()
        X.Jerk.bind(X.Jerk.tool)
    end
end)

function Fling.gunHolder()
    local best
    for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LocalPlayer and p.Character and not isRealNpc(p) and hasItem(p,"Gun") then
            local d=rolesCache[p.Name] or rolesCache[p.UserId] or rolesCache[tostring(p.UserId)]
            local hero=false
            if type(d)=="table" then
                local raw=d.Role or d.role or d.CurrentRole or d.currentRole
                if type(raw)=="string" and raw:lower():find("hero",1,true) then hero=true end
            end
            if not hero and type(getgenv)=="function" then
                pcall(function()
                    local api=getgenv().NoirMM2SA
                    local rc=api and api.State and api.State.roleCache
                    if rc and rc[p.UserId]=="hero" then hero=true end
                end)
            end
            if hero then return p end
            best=best or p
        end
    end
    return best
end
-- find a role target exactly the way the role watcher does: fresh GetPlayerData -> rolesCache first,
-- then the tool/silent-aim fallbacks, so fling murderer/sheriff/hero always resolve the same names
function Fling.roleTarget(role)
    pcall(fetchRoles)
    local wantM, wantS, wantH = role == "Murderer", role == "Sheriff", role == "Hero"
    for name, d in pairs(rolesCache) do
        if type(d) == "table" and not d.Killed and not d.Dead then
            local raw = tostring(d.Role or d.role or d.CurrentRole or d.currentRole or d.Team or d.team or d.Class or ""):lower()
            local hit = (wantM and (raw:find("murder", 1, true) or raw:find("killer", 1, true)))
                or (wantS and raw:find("sheriff", 1, true))
                or (wantH and raw:find("hero", 1, true))
            if hit then
                local p = Players:FindFirstChild(name)
                if not p and tonumber(name) then p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(name)) end
                if p and p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    return p
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and getRole(p) == role then return p end
    end
    if wantS or wantH then
        local g = Fling.gunHolder()
        if g then return g end
    end
    return nil
end
function Fling.all()
    Fling.allRun=Fling.allRun+1
    local id=Fling.allRun
    task.spawn(function()
        for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if Fling.allRun~=id then return end
            if p~=LocalPlayer and p.Character and not isRealNpc(p) and getRole(p)~="NPC" then Fling.run(p) end
        end
    end)
end

    local lastM, lastS, lastH, myRole = nil, nil, nil, nil
    task.spawn(function()
        while not Library.Unloaded do
            task.wait(1)
            pcall(function()
                local m, s, h
                for name, d in pairs(rolesCache) do
                    if type(d) == "table" and not d.Killed and not d.Dead then
                        local rn = tostring(d.Role or d.role or d.CurrentRole or d.currentRole or ""):lower()
                        if rn:find("murder", 1, true) or rn:find("killer", 1, true) then m = name
                        elseif rn:find("sheriff", 1, true) then s = name
                        elseif rn:find("hero", 1, true) then h = name
                        end
                    end
                end
                local mine = rolesCache[LocalPlayer.Name]
                local role = type(mine) == "table" and (mine.Role or mine.role) or nil
                if m or s or h then
                    local roundStart = not lastM and not lastS and not lastH
                    if roundStart then
                        if CFG.warnRoundStart then Library:Notify({Title="round", Text="round started", Duration=4}) end
                        if CFG.warnRole and role then
                            Library:Notify({Title="role", Text="you are " .. tostring(role), Duration=5})
                        end
                    end
                    if CFG.warnRole then
                        if m and m ~= lastM then Library:Notify({Title="role", Text="murderer: " .. m, Duration=6}) end
                        if s and s ~= lastS then Library:Notify({Title="role", Text="sheriff: " .. s, Duration=6}) end
                        if h and h ~= lastH then Library:Notify({Title="role", Text="hero: " .. h, Duration=6}) end
                    end
                    if not roundStart and CFG.warnRole and role and myRole and role ~= myRole then
                        Library:Notify({Title="role", Text="you are now " .. tostring(role), Duration=5})
                    end
                    myRole = role
                    lastM, lastS, lastH = m, s, h
                else
                    if (lastM or lastS or lastH) and CFG.resultFxOn ~= false then

                        task.spawn(function()
                            local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
                            local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if hrp then pcall(DeathFx.play, hrp.Position, true, (hum and hum.Health > 0) and "victory" or "defeat") end
                        end)
                    end
                    lastM, lastS, lastH, myRole = nil, nil, nil, nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

-- furry top picture: body + a separate tail sprite so the tail can wag slowly.
-- if the executor can't load custom files, the furry is rebuilt from frames, so it ALWAYS shows.
local FURRY = {
    body = nil, tail = nil,
    pivot = { x = 275, y = 500 },                     -- tail base, in source-image pixels
    crop  = { x = 241, y = 310, w = 167, h = 235 },   -- tail sprite rect, in source-image pixels
    srcW = 408, srcH = 612,
}
do
    FURRY.body = customAssetFromB64(FURRY_BODY_B64, "piddle_furry_body.png")
    FURRY.tail = customAssetFromB64(FURRY_TAIL_B64, "piddle_furry_tail.png")
    if not (FURRY.body and FURRY.tail) then FURRY.body = nil; FURRY.tail = nil end
end

-- one loop drives the slow tail wag + a tiny standing-breath bob
local function startFurryAnim(tailObj, stageObj)
    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = tick()
        local basePos = stageObj.Position
        while tailObj.Parent and stageObj.Parent and not Library.Unloaded do
            local top = stageObj:FindFirstAncestor("TopImage")
            if top and top.Visible and not Library.Lite then
                local t = tick() - t0
                tailObj.Rotation = math.sin(t / 1.6 * math.pi * 2) * 14
                stageObj.Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.sin(t / 3.1 * math.pi * 2) * 1.3)
            end
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        end
    end)
end

-- frame-drawn fallback furry (used when custom asset loading is unavailable)
local function buildDrawnFurry(stage)
    local C = {
        main = Color3.fromRGB(112, 152, 240), dark = Color3.fromRGB(84, 112, 204),
        belly = Color3.fromRGB(246, 242, 233), line = Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 64),
        pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 170), white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90),
    }
    local function shp(szX, szY, px, py, col, rad, rot, z)
        local f = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(szX, szY), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Rotation = rot or 0, BackgroundColor3 = col,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 2, Parent = stage})
        New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, rad or 6), Parent = f})
        return f
    end
    -- wagging tail group, pivot = its bottom-left corner where it meets the hip
    local dtail = New("Frame", {Name = "DTail", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 80), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 86),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 1, Parent = stage})
    local function tshp(szX, szY, px, py, col, rad, rot)
        local f = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(szX, szY), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Rotation = rot or 0, BackgroundColor3 = col,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Parent = dtail})
        New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, rad or 6), Parent = f})
        return f
    end
    tshp(15, 38, 6, 68, C.dark, 8, 40)
    tshp(13, 31, 14, 50, C.main, 7, 20)
    tshp(11, 25, 19, 34, C.main, 6, 5)
    tshp(8, 14, 22, 20, C.white, 5, -10)
    -- legs
    shp(10, 26, 26, 102, C.dark, 5, 0, 2)
    shp(10, 26, 52, 102, C.dark, 5, 0, 2)
    -- torso + belly + crossed arms
    shp(34, 34, 39, 78, C.main, 13, 0, 3)
    shp(16, 20, 39, 80, C.belly, 8, 0, 4)
    shp(30, 9, 39, 72, C.dark, 5, -8, 5)
    -- head + ears
    shp(44, 40, 39, 38, C.main, 18, 0, 3)
    shp(14, 14, 20, 14, C.main, 3, 18, 3)
    shp(14, 14, 58, 14, C.main, 3, -18, 3)
    shp(7, 7, 20, 15, C.pink, 2, 18, 4)
    shp(7, 7, 58, 15, C.pink, 2, -18, 4)
    -- hair
    shp(40, 14, 39, 22, C.dark, 7, 0, 4)
    shp(12, 18, 17, 32, C.dark, 6, 8, 4)
    shp(12, 18, 61, 32, C.dark, 6, -8, 4)
    -- eyes + blush + mouth
    shp(7, 9, 30, 42, C.line, 3, 0, 5)
    shp(7, 9, 48, 42, C.line, 3, 0, 5)
    shp(3, 3, 31.5, 40, C.white, 2, 0, 6)
    shp(3, 3, 49.5, 40, C.white, 2, 0, 6)
    shp(6, 3, 23, 48, C.pink, 2, 0, 5)
    shp(6, 3, 55, 48, C.pink, 2, 0, 5)
    shp(4, 2, 39, 49, C.line, 1, 0, 5)
    -- flower near the ear
    shp(10, 10, 61, 25, C.white, 5, 0, 6)
    shp(4, 4, 61, 25, C.gold, 2, 0, 7)
    return dtail
end

function X.buildFurryTop(stage)
    for _, ch in ipairs(stage:GetChildren()) do pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end) end
    local tailObj
    if FURRY.body and FURRY.tail then
        New("ImageLabel", {Name = "Body", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = FURRY.body, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Scale, ZIndex = 3, Parent = stage})
        tailObj = New("ImageLabel", {Name = "Tail", Size = UDim2.fromScale(FURRY.crop.w / FURRY.srcW, FURRY.crop.h / FURRY.srcH),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new((FURRY.pivot.x - FURRY.crop.x) / FURRY.crop.w, (FURRY.pivot.y - FURRY.crop.y) / FURRY.crop.h),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(FURRY.pivot.x / FURRY.srcW, FURRY.pivot.y / FURRY.srcH),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = FURRY.tail, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Scale, ZIndex = 2, Parent = stage})
    else
        tailObj = buildDrawnFurry(stage)
    end
    startFurryAnim(tailObj, stage)
end

function X.refreshTopImage()
    if not Win or not Win.TopImg then return end
    local sel = tostring(CFG.topImage or "")
    local known = (sel == "Furry") or (TOP_IMAGES[sel] ~= nil)
    local on = known and (CFG.topImageVisible ~= false)
    Win._topImageOn = on
    local T = Win.TopImg
    local showFurry = on and sel == "Furry"
    local showStatic = on and sel ~= "Furry"
    T.Visible = on
    T.Furry.Visible = showFurry
    T.Img.Visible = showStatic
    if showStatic then T.Img.Image = ResolveImage(TOP_IMAGES[sel] or "") end
    if showFurry and not T.Furry:FindFirstChild("Tail") and not T.Furry:FindFirstChild("DTail") then
        X.buildFurryTop(T.Furry)
    end
end
end

local BT={hooked=false}
function BT.wallOrigin(head,targetPos,targetChar)
    local rp=RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={LocalPlayer.Character,Cam,targetChar}
    local function clear(a,b) return WS:Raycast(a,b-a,rp)==nil end
    if clear(head,targetPos) then return head end
    local toMe=head-targetPos
    local base=toMe.Magnitude>0.1 and toMe.Unit or Vector3.new(0,1,0)
    local dirs={base,Vector3.new(0,1,0),Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(-1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1),Vector3.new(0,0,-1),Vector3.new(0,-1,0),
        Vector3.new(0.7,0.7,0),Vector3.new(-0.7,0.7,0),Vector3.new(0,0.7,0.7),Vector3.new(0,0.7,-0.7),Vector3.new(0.7,0,0.7),Vector3.new(-0.7,0,0.7),Vector3.new(0.7,0,-0.7),Vector3.new(-0.7,0,-0.7)}
    for _,r in ipairs({1.5,3,5,8,12}) do
        for _,d in ipairs(dirs) do
            local p=targetPos+d*r
            if clear(p,targetPos) then return p end
        end
    end
    return targetPos+base*1.2
end

    local old
    old=hookmetamethod(game,"__namecall",newcclosure(function(self,...)
        local method=getnamecallmethod()
        if method=="FireServer" then

                if n=="KnifeThrown" then return "knife" end

                    local a,b=args[1],args[2]

                            local G = getgenv().__NoirTracers

                        end
                    end)
                end
                return old(self,table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
            end
        end
        return old(self,...)
    end))
    BT.hooked=true
end)

end)

local function refreshPlayerCache() SA.cachedPlayers = Players:GetPlayers() end
refreshPlayerCache()
local function getPlayers() return SA.cachedPlayers end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(refreshPlayerCache)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    refreshPlayerCache()
    SA.playerData[player.UserId], SA.roleCache[player.UserId], SA.announcedRoles[player.UserId] = nil, nil, nil
    if SA.murderer == player then SA.murderer = nil end
    if SA.sheriff == player then SA.sheriff = nil end
    if SA.hero == player then SA.hero = nil end
end)

function SA.validTarget(player)
    local character = player and player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    return player ~= nil and player ~= LocalPlayer and character ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

function SA.localCharacter() return LocalPlayer.Character end

function SA.localHumanoid()
    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
    if c ~= SA.localHumChar or not SA.localHumCache or not SA.localHumCache.Parent then
        SA.localHumChar = c
        SA.localHumCache = c and c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") or nil
    end
    return SA.localHumCache
end

function SA.localRoot()
    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
    if c ~= SA.localRootChar or not SA.localRootCache or not SA.localRootCache.Parent then
        SA.localRootChar = c
        SA.localRootCache = c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso")) or nil
    end
    return SA.localRootCache
end

function SA.playerHasTool(player, toolName)
    local character = player and player.Character
    local backpack = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (character and character:FindFirstChild(toolName)) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName))
end

function SA.isFriend(player)
    if not SA.config.ignoreFriends or player == nil then return false end
    local cached = SA.friendCache[player]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
    local ok, res = pcall(function() return player:IsFriendsWith(LocalPlayer.UserId) end)
    local value = (ok and res == true)
    SA.friendCache[player] = value
    return value
end

function SA.distanceTo(player)
    local root = SA.localRoot()
    local targetCharacter = SA.entityCharacter(player)
    local t = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root and t then return (t.Position - root.Position).Magnitude end
    return math.huge
end

function SA.playerIsInLobby(player)
    if not player then return true end
    local teamName = player.Team and string.lower(tostring(player.Team.Name)) or ""
    if string.find(teamName, "lobby", 1, true)
        or string.find(teamName, "spectat", 1, true)
        or string.find(teamName, "observer", 1, true)
        or string.find(teamName, "waiting", 1, true) then
        return true
    end
    local containers = { player, player.Character }
    for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
        if container then
            for key, value in pairs(container:GetAttributes()) do
                local k = string.lower(tostring(key))
                if (string.find(k, "inround", 1, true) or string.find(k, "ingame", 1, true)
                    or string.find(k, "isplaying", 1, true) or string.find(k, "alive", 1, true))
                    and value == false then
                    return true
                end
                if string.find(k, "state", 1, true) or string.find(k, "status", 1, true)
                    or string.find(k, "location", 1, true) or string.find(k, "place", 1, true) then
                    local textValue = string.lower(tostring(value))
                    if string.find(textValue, "lobby", 1, true)
                        or string.find(textValue, "spectat", 1, true)
                        or string.find(textValue, "dead", 1, true)
                        or string.find(textValue, "waiting", 1, true) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, name in ipairs({ "InLobby", "Spectating", "Dead", "IsDead" }) do
                local flag = container:FindFirstChild(name)
                if flag and flag:IsA("BoolValue") and flag.Value then return true end
            end
            for _, name in ipairs({ "InRound", "InGame", "IsPlaying", "Alive", "IsAlive" }) do
                local flag = container:FindFirstChild(name)
                if flag and flag:IsA("BoolValue") and not flag.Value then return true end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

SA.infectionState = { npcs = {}, nextScan = 0, entity = nil, entityAt = 0, markerPlayers = {}, markersAt = 0 }

function SA.entityCharacter(entity)
    if typeof(entity) == "Instance" and entity:IsA("Model") then return entity end
    return (entity and entity.Character) or nil
end

local function zombieWordIn(textValue)
    local lowered = string.lower(tostring(textValue or ""))
    return string.find(lowered, "zomb", 1, true) ~= nil
        or string.find(lowered, "infect", 1, true) ~= nil
        or string.find(lowered, "undead", 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function modelRoot(model)
    return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart) or nil
end

local function modelHasZombieMarker(model)
    if zombieWordIn(model.Name) then return true end
    local ok, hit = pcall(function()
        for key, value in pairs(model:GetAttributes()) do
            if zombieWordIn(key) or (type(value) == "string" and zombieWordIn(value)) then return true end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if (child:IsA("BoolValue") or child:IsA("StringValue")) and zombieWordIn(child.Name) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end)
    return ok and hit or false
end

local function playerHasZombieMarker(player)
    if not player then return false end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - SA.infectionState.markersAt >= 0.5 then
        table.clear(SA.infectionState.markerPlayers)
        SA.infectionState.markersAt = now
    end
    local cached = SA.infectionState.markerPlayers[player]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
    local ok, hit = pcall(function()
        if player.Team and zombieWordIn(player.Team.Name) then return true end
        for key, value in pairs(player:GetAttributes()) do
            if value == true and zombieWordIn(key) then return true end
        end
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            for key, value in pairs(character:GetAttributes()) do
                if value == true and zombieWordIn(key) then return true end
            end
            for _, inst in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if inst:IsA("BoolValue") and inst.Value and zombieWordIn(inst.Name) then return true end
                if (inst:IsA("StringValue") or inst:IsA("IntValue") or inst:IsA("ObjectValue"))
                    and zombieWordIn(inst.Name) then return true end
            end
        end
        return false
    end)
    hit = ok and hit or false
    SA.infectionState.markerPlayers[player] = hit
    return hit
end

local function localHasGun()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil)
        or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil) or false
end

local function infectionRoundActive()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - SA.infectionAt < 0.8 then return SA.infectionSignal end
    SA.infectionAt = now
    SA.infectionSignal = false
    pcall(function()
        for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and playerHasZombieMarker(player) then SA.infectionSignal = true break end
        end
    end)
    if not SA.infectionSignal then
        pcall(function()
            local hasKnife, gunCount = false, 0
            if localHasGun() then gunCount += 1 end
            for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer and SA.validTarget(player) then
                    if SA.playerHasTool(player, "Knife") then hasKnife = true end
                    if SA.playerHasTool(player, "Gun") then gunCount += 1 end
                end
            end
            if not hasKnife and gunCount >= 2 then SA.infectionSignal = true end
        end)
    end
    if not SA.infectionSignal then
        pcall(function()
            for _, model in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if model:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
                    and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and modelHasZombieMarker(model) then
                    SA.infectionSignal = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    return SA.infectionSignal
end

local function scanZombieNPCs(force)
    local now = os.clock()
    if not force and now < SA.infectionState.nextScan then return SA.infectionState.npcs end
    SA.infectionState.nextScan = now + 1.2
    local strict, loose = {}, {}
    pcall(function()
        for _, model in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if model:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
                local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local root = modelRoot(model)
                if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
                    if modelHasZombieMarker(model) then
                        strict[#strict + 1] = model
                    else
                        loose[#loose + 1] = model
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    if #strict > 0 then
        SA.infectionState.npcs = strict
    else
        local signal = localHasGun()
        if not signal then
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer and playerHasZombieMarker(player) then
                    signal = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        SA.infectionState.npcs = signal and loose or {}
    end
    return SA.infectionState.npcs
end

local function nearestZombieEntity()
    if not infectionRoundActive() then return nil end
    local now = os.clock()
    if SA.infectionState.entity and now - SA.infectionState.entityAt < 0.35 then
        local cached = SA.infectionState.entity
        local stillOk = false
        pcall(function()
            if typeof(cached) == "Instance" and cached.Parent then
                if cached:IsA("Model") then
                    local humanoid = cached:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    stillOk = humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and modelRoot(cached) ~= nil
                else
                    stillOk = SA.validTarget(cached) and cached.Character ~= nil
                end
            end
        end)
        if stillOk then return cached end
        SA.infectionState.entity = nil
    end
    local origin = SA.localRoot()
    if not origin then return nil end
    local best, bestDistance
    local function consider(candidate, candidateRoot)
        if not candidateRoot then return end
        local d = (candidateRoot.Position - origin.Position).Magnitude
        if SA.config.maxDistance > 0 and d > SA.config.maxDistance then return end
        if SA.config.fovSize > 0 then
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                local screen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(candidateRoot.Position)
                local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
                if screen.Z <= 0 or (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude > SA.config.fovSize / 2 then return end
            end
        end
        if not bestDistance or d < bestDistance then best, bestDistance = candidate, d end
    end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and SA.validTarget(player)
            and not SA.playerIsInLobby(player) and playerHasZombieMarker(player) then
            local character = player.Character
            consider(player, character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil)
        end
    end

    if not best then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and SA.validTarget(player)
                and not SA.playerIsInLobby(player) and not SA.isFriend(player)
                and not SA.playerHasTool(player, "Gun") then
                local character = player.Character
                consider(player, character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil)
            end
        end
    end
    for _, model in ipairs(scanZombieNPCs()) do
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then consider(model, modelRoot(model)) end
    end

    if best and bestDistance then
        local current = SA.infectionState.entity
        if current and current ~= best and typeof(current) == "Instance" and current.Parent then
            local currentRoot
            pcall(function()
                if current:IsA("Model") then currentRoot = modelRoot(current)
                elseif SA.validTarget(current) then currentRoot = current.Character and current.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil end
            end)
            if currentRoot and (currentRoot.Position - origin.Position).Magnitude <= bestDistance + 8 then best = current end
        end
    end
    SA.infectionState.entity = best
    SA.infectionState.entityAt = now
    return best
end

function SA.setTarget(player)
    if not SA.validTarget(player) then player = nil end
    SA.murderer = player
end

function SA.findByKnife()
    for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and SA.playerHasTool(player, "Knife") then return player end
    end
end

function SA.findByGun()
    for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and SA.playerHasTool(player, "Gun") then return player end
    end
end

function SA.findSheriff()
    if SA.validTarget(SA.sheriff) then return SA.sheriff end
    return SA.findByGun()
end

function SA.getPlayerDataRemote()
    if SA.playerDataRemote and SA.playerDataRemote.Parent then return SA.playerDataRemote end
    local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GetPlayerData", true)
    SA.playerDataRemote = (remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")) and remote or nil
    return SA.playerDataRemote
end

function SA.consumeData(data, fullSnapshot)
    if typeof(data) ~= "table" then return false end
    local records = (typeof(data.Players) == "table" and data.Players) or (typeof(data.players) == "table" and data.players) or data
    local lookup = {}
    for key, info in pairs(records) do
        local keyText = string.lower(tostring(key))
        lookup[keyText] = info
        if typeof(info) == "table" then
            for _, identity in ipairs({ info.Name, info.PlayerName, info.Username, info.UserId, info.UserID, info.Id, info.PlayerId }) do
                if identity ~= nil then lookup[string.lower(tostring(identity))] = info end
            end
        end
    end
    local function normalizeRole(info)
        if typeof(info) == "table" then
            if info.Dead == true or info.Killed == true or info.IsDead == true or info.Alive == false then return "dead" end
            info = info.Role or info.role or info.CurrentRole or info.currentRole or info.Team or info.team or info.Class
        end
        local value = string.lower(tostring(info or "innocent")):gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
        if string.find(value, "murder", 1, true) or string.find(value, "killer", 1, true) then return "murderer" end
        if string.find(value, "sheriff", 1, true) then return "sheriff" end
        if string.find(value, "hero", 1, true) then return "hero" end
        if string.find(value, "dead", 1, true) or string.find(value, "killed", 1, true) then return "dead" end
        return "innocent"
    end
    local foundMurderer, foundSheriff, foundHero, received, changed = nil, nil, nil, false, false
    for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
        local info = lookup[string.lower(player.Name)] or lookup[tostring(player.UserId)] or lookup[string.lower(tostring(player.UserId))]
        if info ~= nil then
            received = true
            SA.playerData[player.UserId] = info
            local resolved = normalizeRole(info)
            if SA.roleCache[player.UserId] ~= resolved then
                -- silent aim keeps its cache in sync, but role announcements come from the role watcher only
                SA.roleCache[player.UserId], changed = resolved, true
                SA.announcedRoles[player.UserId] = resolved
            end
            if resolved == "murderer" then foundMurderer = player
            elseif resolved == "sheriff" then foundSheriff = player
            elseif resolved == "hero" then foundHero = player end
        elseif fullSnapshot and SA.roleCache[player.UserId] ~= "innocent" then
            SA.roleCache[player.UserId], changed = "innocent", true
        end
    end
    local previousMurderer, previousSheriff, previousHero = SA.murderer, SA.sheriff, SA.hero
    if fullSnapshot then
        SA.murderer, SA.sheriff, SA.hero = foundMurderer, foundSheriff, foundHero
    else
        SA.murderer, SA.sheriff, SA.hero = foundMurderer or SA.murderer, foundSheriff or SA.sheriff, foundHero or SA.hero
    end
    if foundMurderer then SA.setTarget(foundMurderer) end
    if previousMurderer ~= SA.murderer or previousSheriff ~= SA.sheriff or previousHero ~= SA.hero then changed = true end
    return received
end

SA.Scanner = { busy = false, queued = false, delayed = false, force = false, last = -1e9 }
function SA.Scanner:Request(force)
    self.force = self.force or force == true
    if self.busy then self.queued = true; return end
    local interval = 0.8
    local elapsed = os.clock() - self.last
    if not self.force and elapsed < interval then
        self.queued = true
        if not self.delayed then
            self.delayed = true
            task.delay(interval - elapsed, function()
                SA.Scanner.delayed = false
                if SA.Scanner.queued then SA.Scanner.queued = false; SA.Scanner:Request(false) end
            end)
        end
        return
    end
    self.busy, self.queued = true, false
    self.force = false
    task.spawn(function()
        local knifeOwner, gunOwner = SA.findByKnife(), SA.findByGun()
        local fallbackChanged = false
        if knifeOwner and SA.roleCache[knifeOwner.UserId] ~= "murderer" then
            for userId, role in pairs(SA.roleCache) do if role == "murderer" then SA.roleCache[userId] = "innocent" end end
            SA.roleCache[knifeOwner.UserId], fallbackChanged = "murderer", true
            SA.setTarget(knifeOwner)
        end
        if gunOwner and gunOwner ~= knifeOwner and SA.roleCache[gunOwner.UserId] ~= "sheriff" then
            for userId, role in pairs(SA.roleCache) do if role == "sheriff" then SA.roleCache[userId] = "innocent" end end
            SA.roleCache[gunOwner.UserId], SA.sheriff, fallbackChanged = "sheriff", gunOwner, true
        end
        local applied = false
        local remote = SA.getPlayerDataRemote()
        if remote then
            local ok, data = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer() end)
            if ok then applied = SA.consumeData(data, true) end
        end
        if not applied and not knifeOwner then SA.setTarget(nil) end
        SA.Scanner.last, SA.Scanner.busy = os.clock(), false
        if SA.Scanner.queued then SA.Scanner.queued = false; SA.Scanner:Request(false) end
    end)
end

function SA.getAimPart(player)
    local char = SA.entityCharacter(player)
    if not char then return nil end
    local partName = SA.config.hitPart
    if partName == "Random" then
        local opts = { "Head", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "HumanoidRootPart" }
        partName = opts[math.random(#opts)]
    end
    local part = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
    if not part then part = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart end
    return part
end

function SA.inFOV(player)
    if SA.config.fovSize <= 0 then return true end
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local part = SA.getAimPart(player)
    if not cam or not part then return false end
    local screen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    return (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude <= SA.config.fovSize / 2
end

function SA.passesFilters(player, trusted)
    if player == nil or player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if not SA.validTarget(player) then return false end
    if not trusted and SA.playerIsInLobby(player) then return false end
    if SA.isFriend(player) then return false end
    if SA.config.maxDistance > 0 and SA.distanceTo(player) > SA.config.maxDistance then return false end
    return true
end

function SA.selectTarget(mode)
    if infectionRoundActive() then
        local zombieEntity = nearestZombieEntity()
        if zombieEntity then return zombieEntity end
    end
    mode = mode or SA.config.targetMode
    if mode == "Murderer" then return SA.passesFilters(SA.murderer, true) and SA.murderer or nil end
    if mode == "Sheriff" then return SA.passesFilters(SA.sheriff, true) and SA.sheriff or nil end
    if mode == "Hero" then return SA.passesFilters(SA.hero, true) and SA.hero or nil end
    if mode == "Selected" then
        local p = SA.config.selectedPlayer and Players:FindFirstChild(SA.config.selectedPlayer)
        return SA.passesFilters(p, true) and p or nil
    end
    if mode == "Nearest" then
        local best, bd
        for _, p in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
            if SA.passesFilters(p) then local d = SA.distanceTo(p); if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = p, d end end
        end
        return best
    end
    if mode == "Crosshair" then
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local best, bd
        if cam then
            local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
            for _, p in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
                if SA.passesFilters(p) then
                    local part = SA.getAimPart(p)
                    if part then
                        local screen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                        if screen.Z > 0 then
                            local d = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
                            if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = p, d end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    if mode == "Lowest Health" then
        local best, bh
        for _, p in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
            if SA.passesFilters(p) then
                local hum = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
                local h = hum and hum.Health or math.huge
                if not bh or h < bh then best, bh = p, h end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    if mode == "Random" then
        local list = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(getPlayers()) do if SA.passesFilters(p) then list[#list + 1] = p end end
        if #list > 0 then return list[math.random(#list)] end
        return nil
    end
    return SA.passesFilters(SA.murderer, true) and SA.murderer or nil
end

function SA.targetPart()
    local player = SA.selectTarget()
    if not player then player = SA.findByKnife() end
    local character = SA.entityCharacter(player)
    if not character then return nil end
    return SA.getAimPart(player) or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
end

function SA.findNearestKnifeTarget()
    local root = SA.localRoot()
    if not root then return nil end
    local closest, closestDistance
    for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
        if SA.passesFilters(player) then
            local targetRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                local d = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if not closestDistance or d < closestDistance then closest, closestDistance = player, d end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

function SA.knifeTargetPlayer()
    if not SA.config.knifeEnabled then return nil end
    if SA.config.knifePrioritizeSheriff == true then
        local sheriffPlayer = SA.findSheriff()
        return SA.passesFilters(sheriffPlayer, true) and sheriffPlayer or nil
    end
    return SA.findNearestKnifeTarget()
end

function SA.knifeTargetPart()
    local player = SA.knifeTargetPlayer()
    local character = player and player.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    return SA.getAimPart(player) or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
end

SA.PingProfiles = {
    { Ping = 20,  Sim = 48, Interval = 70, H = 154, V = 144, X = -5,  Y = -14, Z = 0 },
    { Ping = 50,  Sim = 54, Interval = 66, H = 162, V = 152, X = -6,  Y = -14, Z = 0 },
    { Ping = 100, Sim = 68, Interval = 60, H = 176, V = 166, X = -8,  Y = -15, Z = 0 },
    { Ping = 150, Sim = 72, Interval = 64, H = 182, V = 170, X = -9,  Y = -12, Z = 0 },
    { Ping = 200, Sim = 76, Interval = 70, H = 188, V = 174, X = -10, Y = -11, Z = 0 },
    { Ping = 300, Sim = 82, Interval = 76, H = 196, V = 180, X = -12, Y = -10, Z = 0 },
}

function SA.interpolateProfile(ping)
    local a, b = SA.PingProfiles[1], SA.PingProfiles[1]
    if ping >= SA.PingProfiles[#SA.PingProfiles].Ping then
        a, b = SA.PingProfiles[#SA.PingProfiles], SA.PingProfiles[#SA.PingProfiles]
    else
        for index = 1, #SA.PingProfiles - 1 do
            if ping >= SA.PingProfiles[index].Ping and ping <= SA.PingProfiles[index + 1].Ping then a, b = SA.PingProfiles[index], SA.PingProfiles[index + 1]; break end
        end
    end
    local span = b.Ping - a.Ping
    local alpha = span > 0 and math.clamp((ping - a.Ping) / span, 0, 1) or 0
    alpha = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha)
    local function mix(key) return a[key] + (b[key] - a[key]) * alpha end
    return { Sim = math.floor(mix("Sim") + 0.5), Interval = math.floor(mix("Interval") + 0.5),
        H = math.floor(mix("H") + 0.5), V = math.floor(mix("V") + 0.5),
        X = math.floor(mix("X") + 0.5), Y = math.floor(mix("Y") + 0.5), Z = math.floor(mix("Z") + 0.5) }
end

function SA.updatePing()
    pcall(function()
        local network = Stats:FindFirstChild("Network")
        local items = network and network:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
        local pingItem = items and items:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")
        if pingItem then
            local measured = pingItem:GetValue() / 1000
            if measured > 0 and measured < 2 then SA.cachedPing = SA.cachedPing * 0.7 + measured * 0.3 end
        end
    end)
end

function SA.autoTuneForPing()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - SA.lastAutoTune < 0.4 then return end
    SA.lastAutoTune = now
    local pingMs = math.clamp(math.floor(SA.cachedPing * 1000 + 0.5), 5, 1000)
    if SA.config.prioritizePing and SA.config.manualPingMs ~= pingMs then SA.config.manualPingMs = pingMs end
    if SA.config.knifeAim.prioritizePing and SA.config.knifeAim.manualPingMs ~= pingMs then SA.config.knifeAim.manualPingMs = pingMs end
end

function SA.leadTime(profile)
    local settings = profile == "knife" and SA.config.knifeAim or SA.config
    local observedPing = settings.prioritizePing and SA.cachedPing or (settings.manualPingMs / 1000)
    local prediction
    if settings.adaptive then
        prediction = observedPing + settings.extraLead
        if settings.predictLag then
            local samplingDelay = math.clamp(settings.predictionIntervalMs / 2000, 0, 0.05)
            prediction = prediction + samplingDelay + math.max(0, observedPing - 0.10) * 0.15
        end
    else
        prediction = settings.fixedLead
    end
    local simulationCap = settings.maxSimulationMs / 1000
    if settings.adaptive then
        simulationCap = math.min(0.30, simulationCap + math.clamp(observedPing - 0.10, 0, 0.25) * 0.45)
    end
    return math.clamp(prediction, 0.02, simulationCap)
end

local function motionRoot(part)

    if not part then return part end
    local model = part.Parent
    if model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        return model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or part
    end
    return part
end

function SA.sampleMotion(part, settings)
    settings = settings or SA.config
    part = motionRoot(part)
    if not part then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if SA.motionPart ~= part then
        SA.motionPart = part; SA.motionSamples = {}; SA.measuredVelocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        SA.previousEstimatedVelocity = SA.measuredVelocity; SA.estimatedAcceleration = Vector3.zero
    end
    local lastSample = SA.motionSamples[#SA.motionSamples]
    if lastSample and now - lastSample.time > 0.35 then

        SA.motionSamples = {}; SA.measuredVelocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        SA.previousEstimatedVelocity = SA.measuredVelocity; SA.estimatedAcceleration = Vector3.zero
    end

    local interval = math.clamp((tonumber(settings.predictionIntervalMs) or 72) / 1000, 0.016, 0.05)
    local last = SA.motionSamples[#SA.motionSamples]
    if not last or now - last.time >= interval then
        SA.motionSamples[#SA.motionSamples + 1] = { position = part.Position, time = now }
        while #SA.motionSamples > 14 or (#SA.motionSamples > 3 and now - SA.motionSamples[1].time > 0.28) do table.remove(SA.motionSamples, 1) end
        local count = #SA.motionSamples
        if count >= 2 then
            local newest, previous = SA.motionSamples[count], SA.motionSamples[count - 1]
            local dt = newest.time - previous.time
            if dt > 0.004 then
                local recent = (newest.position - previous.position) / dt
                local sampled = recent
                if count >= 4 then

                    local t0 = SA.motionSamples[1].time
                    local n, st, sx, sz = 0, 0, 0, 0
                    for i = 1, count do
                        local s = SA.motionSamples[i]; local t = s.time - t0
                        n = n + 1; st = st + t; sx = sx + s.position.X; sz = sz + s.position.Z
                    end
                    local mt, mx, mz = st / n, sx / n, sz / n
                    local numX, numZ, den = 0, 0, 0
                    for i = 1, count do
                        local s = SA.motionSamples[i]; local t = s.time - t0
                        numX = numX + (t - mt) * (s.position.X - mx)
                        numZ = numZ + (t - mt) * (s.position.Z - mz)
                        den = den + (t - mt) * (t - mt)
                    end
                    if den > 0.0001 then
                        sampled = recent:Lerp(Vector3.new(numX / den, recent.Y, numZ / den), 0.5)
                    end
                end
                if sampled.Magnitude < 250 then
                    local oldVelocity = SA.measuredVelocity
                    SA.measuredVelocity = SA.measuredVelocity:Lerp(sampled, math.clamp(dt * 26, 0.45, 1))
                    local acceleration = (SA.measuredVelocity - oldVelocity) / math.max(dt, 0.016)
                    if acceleration.Magnitude < 160 then SA.estimatedAcceleration = SA.estimatedAcceleration:Lerp(acceleration, 0.3)
                    else SA.estimatedAcceleration = Vector3.zero end
                    SA.previousEstimatedVelocity = oldVelocity
                end
            end
        end
    end
    SA.motionPosition = part.Position; SA.motionTime = now
end

function SA.motionState(root, settings)
    SA.sampleMotion(root, settings)
    local assembly = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local velocity, acceleration = assembly, Vector3.zero
    if settings.predictLag and SA.motionPart == root and #SA.motionSamples >= 2 then
        local measured = SA.measuredVelocity
        local disagreement = (assembly - measured).Magnitude
        local weight = math.clamp(0.75 - disagreement / 120, 0.35, 0.75)

        if assembly.X * measured.X + assembly.Z * measured.Z < 0 then weight = 0.15 end
        if assembly.Magnitude < 2.5 then weight = math.min(weight, 0.25) end
        velocity = assembly:Lerp(measured, weight)
        acceleration = SA.estimatedAcceleration
    end

    if Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude < 1 then
        velocity = Vector3.new(0, velocity.Y, 0)
        acceleration = Vector3.new(0, acceleration.Y, 0)
    end
    return velocity, acceleration
end

function SA.floorDrop(root)
    local params = SA.predictParams
    if not params then
        params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        SA.predictParams = params
    end
    local filter = { root.Parent }
    if LocalPlayer.Character then filter[#filter + 1] = LocalPlayer.Character end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    local hit = Workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -150, 0), params)
    if not hit then return nil end
    local humanoid = root.Parent and root.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    local hip = humanoid and humanoid.HipHeight or 0
    if hip < 1.5 then hip = 2 end
    return math.max(0, hit.Distance - (hip + root.Size.Y / 2))
end

function SA.predictDisplacement(root, velocity, acceleration, time, settings)
    local horizontal = (tonumber(settings.horizontalMultiplier) or 100) / 100
    local vertical = (tonumber(settings.verticalMultiplier) or 100) / 100
    local rawFlat = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
    local flatVelocity = rawFlat * horizontal
    local displacement = flatVelocity * time
    if settings.predictLag then
        local flatAcceleration = Vector3.new(acceleration.X, 0, acceleration.Z)
        local rawSpeed = rawFlat.Magnitude
        if rawSpeed > 0.1 and flatAcceleration.Magnitude > 0.25 then
            local effective = time
            local alongMotion = flatAcceleration:Dot(rawFlat.Unit)

            if alongMotion < -0.01 then effective = math.min(time, rawSpeed / -alongMotion) end
            local shift = flatAcceleration * (0.5 * effective * effective)
            local limit = math.max(2, rawSpeed * horizontal * time * 0.6)
            if shift.Magnitude > limit then shift = shift.Unit * limit end
            displacement = flatVelocity * effective + shift
        end
    end
    if settings.predictJump then
        local verticalTime = time * vertical
        local lift = velocity.Y * verticalTime
        local humanoid = root.Parent and root.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
            lift = lift - 0.5 * Workspace.Gravity * verticalTime * verticalTime
            local drop = SA.floorDrop(root)
            if drop and lift < -drop then lift = -drop end
        end
        displacement = displacement + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
    end

    local flat = Vector3.new(displacement.X, 0, displacement.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude > 60 then
        flat = flat.Unit * 60
        displacement = Vector3.new(flat.X, displacement.Y, flat.Z)
    end
    return displacement
end

function SA.calculateAim(part)
    local settings = SA.config
    local root = motionRoot(part)
    local velocity, acceleration = SA.motionState(root, settings)
    local time = math.clamp(SA.leadTime(), 0.02, 0.60)
    local displacement = SA.predictDisplacement(root, velocity, acceleration, time, settings)
    local offset = Vector3.new(part.Size.X * settings.offsetX / 100, part.Size.Y * settings.offsetY / 100, part.Size.Z * settings.offsetZ / 100)
    return part.Position + displacement + offset
end

function SA.calculateKnifeAim(part, origin)
    local settings = SA.config.knifeAim
    local root = motionRoot(part)
    local velocity, acceleration = SA.motionState(root, settings)
    local lead = SA.leadTime("knife")
    local offset = Vector3.new(part.Size.X * settings.offsetX / 100, part.Size.Y * settings.offsetY / 100, part.Size.Z * settings.offsetZ / 100)
    local time = math.clamp(lead + math.clamp((part.Position - origin).Magnitude / 125, 0, 0.55), 0.03, 0.90)
    local aim = part.Position
    for _ = 1, 3 do
        aim = part.Position + SA.predictDisplacement(root, velocity, acceleration, time, settings) + offset
        time = math.clamp(lead + math.clamp((aim - origin).Magnitude / 125, 0, 0.55), 0.03, 0.90)
    end
    return aim
end

SA.wallCheckParams = RaycastParams.new()
SA.wallCheckParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
SA.wallCheckParams.IgnoreWater = true

function SA.targetVisible(part, forceWallCheck)
    if not (forceWallCheck or SA.config.wallCheck) then return true end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local originPart = character and (character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if not originPart or not part then return false end
    SA.wallCheckParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(originPart.Position, part.Position - originPart.Position, SA.wallCheckParams)
    return result == nil or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function piercerShotOrigin(origin, aim, part, enabled)
    if not enabled or not origin or not aim or not part then return origin end
    local direction = aim - origin
    local distance = direction.Magnitude
    if distance <= 0.05 then return origin end
    local dir = direction.Unit
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    local filter = { character, part.Parent }
    local gun = (character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun"))
    if gun then filter[#filter + 1] = gun end
    for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
        if player.Character and player.Character ~= character then filter[#filter + 1] = player.Character end
    end
    SA.wallCheckParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    local blocked = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * distance, SA.wallCheckParams)
    if not blocked then return origin end
    local inner = Workspace:Raycast(aim, -dir * distance, SA.wallCheckParams)
    local candidate = inner and (inner.Position + dir * 0.9) or (aim - dir * 0.9)
    if (aim - candidate).Magnitude > 0.02 and not Workspace:Raycast(candidate, aim - candidate, SA.wallCheckParams) then
        return candidate
    end
    candidate = aim - dir * 0.5
    if (aim - candidate).Magnitude > 0.02 and not Workspace:Raycast(candidate, aim - candidate, SA.wallCheckParams) then
        return candidate
    end
    return aim - dir * 0.4
end

local function localGunTool()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun"))
end

local function remoteBelongsToLocalGun(remote)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    local tool = remote and remote:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
    if tool and tool.Name == "Gun" and ((character and tool:IsDescendantOf(character)) or (backpack and tool:IsDescendantOf(backpack))) then return true end
    local characterGun = character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
    local backpackGun = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
    return (characterGun and remote:IsDescendantOf(characterGun)) or (backpackGun and remote:IsDescendantOf(backpackGun))
end

local function shotRemote(remote, args)
    if not (SA.config.enabled or SA.config.piercerBullet or SA.buttonShotActive) or args.n < 2 then return false end
    if typeof(remote) ~= "Instance" or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false end
    if not remoteBelongsToLocalGun(remote) then return false end
    local first, second = args[1], args[2]
    local firstIsPos = typeof(first) == "Vector3" or typeof(first) == "CFrame"
    local secondIsPos = typeof(second) == "Vector3" or typeof(second) == "CFrame"
    return firstIsPos and secondIsPos
end

local function hasCFrameArgument(args)
    for index = 1, args.n do
        if typeof(args[index]) == "CFrame" then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function knifeRemote(remote, args)
    if not SA.config.knifeEnabled or args.n < 2 then return false end
    if typeof(remote) ~= "Instance" or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false end
    if remote.Name ~= "KnifeThrown" then return false end
    if typeof(args[1]) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(args[2]) ~= "CFrame" then return false end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    local knife = character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
    if knife and remote:IsDescendantOf(knife) then return true end
    if character and remote:IsDescendantOf(character) then return true end
    if backpack and remote:IsDescendantOf(backpack) then return true end
    return false
end

function SA.redirect(remote, args)
    local part, useWallCheck, isKnife = nil, false, false
    if shotRemote(remote, args) then
        if not SA.buttonShotActive and SA.config.aimKey ~= "None" and not SA.aimHeld then return end
        if SA.config.shotMethod == "CFrame" and not hasCFrameArgument(args) then return end
        part = (SA.buttonShotActive and SA.buttonShotTarget and SA.getAimPart(SA.buttonShotTarget)) or SA.targetPart()
        useWallCheck = SA.config.wallCheck and not SA.config.piercerBullet
    elseif knifeRemote(remote, args) then
        part = SA.knifeTargetPart(); useWallCheck = SA.config.knifeWallCheck; isKnife = true
    else
        return
    end
    if not part or typeof(part) ~= "Instance" or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if useWallCheck and not SA.targetVisible(part, true) then return end

    if isKnife then

        local origin = args[1].Position
        local aim = SA.calculateKnifeAim(part, origin)
        if SA.config.alignDirection and (aim - origin).Magnitude > 0.01 then
            args[1] = CFrame.lookAt(origin, aim)
        end
        args[2] = CFrame.new(aim)
        SA.redirected = SA.redirected + 1
        return
    end

    local aim = SA.calculateAim(part)
    local firstType, secondType = typeof(args[1]), typeof(args[2])
    if firstType == "CFrame" then
        local origin = args[1].Position
        local shotOrigin = piercerShotOrigin(origin, aim, part, SA.config.piercerBullet)
        if (SA.config.alignDirection or shotOrigin ~= origin) and (aim - shotOrigin).Magnitude > 0.01 then
            args[1] = CFrame.lookAt(shotOrigin, aim)
        end
        if secondType == "CFrame" then
            args[2] = CFrame.new(aim)
        elseif secondType == "Vector3" then
            args[2] = aim
        else
            return
        end
    elseif firstType == "Vector3" then
        local origin = args[1]
        local shotOrigin = piercerShotOrigin(origin, aim, part, SA.config.piercerBullet)
        args[1] = shotOrigin
        if secondType == "Vector3" then
            if args[2].Magnitude <= 1.5 and (aim - shotOrigin).Magnitude > 0.01 then
                args[2] = (aim - shotOrigin).Unit
            else
                args[2] = aim
            end
        elseif secondType == "CFrame" then
            args[2] = CFrame.new(aim)
        else
            return
        end
    else
        return
    end
    SA.redirected = SA.redirected + 1
end

function SA.installHook()
    if SA.hooked then return true end
    local wrap = type(newcclosure) == "function" and newcclosure or function(callback) return callback end
    local isOwnCall = type(checkcaller) == "function" and checkcaller or function() return false end
    if type(hookmetamethod) == "function" and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function" then
        local old
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            old = hookmetamethod(game, "_namecall", wrap(function(self, ...)
                local method = getnamecallmethod()
                local methodLower = string.lower(tostring(method or ""))
                if (methodLower == "fireserver" or methodLower == "invokeserver" or methodLower == "fire") and typeof(self) == "Instance" then
                    if self.ClassName == "RemoteEvent" and methodLower == "fireserver" and not isOwnCall() then
                        local args = table.pack(...)
                        pcall(SA.redirect, self, args)
                        if type(setnamecallmethod) == "function" then setnamecallmethod(method) end
                        return old(self, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
                    end
                end
                return old(self, ...)
            end))
        end)
        if ok and type(old) == "function" then
            SA.hooked = true
            return true
        end
        notify("Namecall hook failed: " .. tostring(err), 5)
    end
    if type(hookfunction) ~= "function" then notify("No hook support in this executor", 6) return false end
    local probe = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    local original
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        original = hookfunction(probe.FireServer, wrap(function(self, ...)
            local args = table.pack(...)
            if typeof(self) == "Instance" then
                if self.ClassName == "RemoteEvent" and not isOwnCall() then pcall(SA.redirect, self, args) end
            end
            return original(self, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
        end))
    end)
    probe:Destroy()
    if not ok or type(original) ~= "function" then notify("Hook failed: " .. tostring(err), 6) return false end
    SA.hooked = true
    return true
end

function SA.toggle(value)
    SA.config.enabled = value == true
    if SA.config.enabled then
        if not SA.installHook() then SA.config.enabled = false return end
        task.spawn(function() SA.Scanner:Request(true) end)
        notify("Enabled", 2)
    else
        notify("Disabled", 2)
    end
    if SA.refreshPanel then pcall(SA.refreshPanel) end
end

function SA.findGunRemote()
    local gun = localGunTool()
    if not gun then return nil end
    local best, bestScore
    for _, object in ipairs(gun:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            local name = object.Name
            local score = #name
            if name == "Shoot" then score += 50 end
            if name == "GunFired" or name == "KnifeThrown" then score = -1 end
            if score >= (bestScore or 0) then best, bestScore = object, score end
        end
    end
    return best
end

function SA.fireGunAt(player, usePrediction)
    if SA.shootBusy then return false end
    SA.shootBusy = true
    local success = false
    pcall(function()
        local zombieModel = typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Model")
            and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil
        if not SA.validTarget(player) and not zombieModel then return end
        local part = SA.getAimPart(player)
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if not part or not character or not humanoid then return end
        if SA.config.wallCheck and not SA.config.piercerBullet and not SA.targetVisible(part) then return end
        local autoEquipped = false
        local gun = character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
        if not gun and backpack then
            gun = backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
            if gun then humanoid:EquipTool(gun); autoEquipped = true; task.wait(0.10) end
        end
        if not gun or not gun:IsA("Tool") then
            if autoEquipped and humanoid.Parent then humanoid:UnequipTools() end
            return
        end
        local remote = SA.findGunRemote()
        local handle = gun:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
        if not remote or not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then
            if autoEquipped and humanoid.Parent then humanoid:UnequipTools() end
            return
        end
        local aim = usePrediction == false and part.Position or SA.calculateAim(part)
        local origin = handle.Position
        local shotOrigin = piercerShotOrigin(origin, aim, part, SA.config.piercerBullet)
        SA.buttonShotActive = true
        SA.buttonShotTarget = player
        success = pcall(function() remote:FireServer(CFrame.lookAt(shotOrigin, aim), CFrame.new(aim)) end)
        task.wait(0.10)
        if autoEquipped and humanoid.Parent then
            task.wait(0.05)
            humanoid:UnequipTools()
        end
    end)
    SA.buttonShotActive = false
    SA.buttonShotTarget = nil
    SA.shootBusy = false
    return success
end

function SA.shootTarget()
    local player = SA.selectTarget()
    if not player then player = SA.findByKnife(); SA.Scanner:Request(true) end
    if player then return SA.fireGunAt(player) end
    return false
end

task.spawn(function()
    while SA.running do
        local active = SA.config.autoFire and SA.config.enabled and (SA.config.autoFireKey == "None" or SA.autoFireHeld)
        if active then
            local player = SA.selectTarget()
            if player and SA.inFOV(player) then
                local part = SA.getAimPart(player)
                if part and (SA.config.piercerBullet or not SA.config.wallCheck or SA.targetVisible(part)) then SA.fireGunAt(player) end
            end
            task.wait(0.03)
        else
            task.wait(0.18)
        end
    end
end)

function BT.bind(tool)
    if not tool:IsA("Tool") or tool.Name~="Gun" then return end
    Connect(tool.Activated,function()
        if BT.hooked then return end
        local ch=LocalPlayer.Character
        local head=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        local loc=UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        if loc.Magnitude<1 then loc=Cam.ViewportSize/2 end
        local ray=Cam:ViewportPointToRay(loc.X,loc.Y)
        local params=RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={ch}
        local hit=WS:Raycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*1000,params)
        local o = head.Position
        local t = hit and hit.Position or (ray.Origin+ray.Direction*500)
        if getgenv().__NoirTracers then
            local G = getgenv().__NoirTracers
            if G.on and G.build then G.shot(o, t, G.impact, G.muzzle) end
        end
    end)
end
function BT.all()
    for _,c in ipairs({LocalPlayer.Character,LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")}) do
        if c then
            for _,tool in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do BT.bind(tool) end
            Connect(c.ChildAdded,BT.bind)
        end
    end
end
