local C_LED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 50)
function MG.minesweeper(diff, ses)
    local n = MSIZE[diff]
    local seed = ses and ses.seed or math.random(1, 2000000000)
    local g = MS.new(n, seed)
    local c = math.floor(n / 2)
    MS.reveal(g, c, c)
    local vw = math.min(n, 18)
    local cs = 18
    local ox = math.clamp(c - math.floor(vw / 2), 0, n - vw)
    local oy = ox
    local flagMode, t0, finished = false, os.clock(), false
    local myRes, oppRes
    setContent(vw * cs + 2, vw * cs + 58)
    setTitle("Minesweeper " .. n .. "x" .. n, diff, ses and ses.opp, ACC.ms)

    local function ledBox(x, w)
        local f = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 2), BackgroundColor3 = C_LED_BG, Parent = gwBody})
        corner(f, 3); stroke(f, C_FACE_SH, 1)
        return f
    end
    local ledM = ledBox(0, 58)
    local ledT = ledBox(vw * cs + 2 - 58, 58)
    local ledML = txt(ledM, "", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), nil, 14, C_LED, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
    local ledTL = txt(ledT, "", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), nil, 14, C_LED, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
    local smiley = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C_FACE, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = gwBody})
    corner(smiley, 12); stroke(smiley, C_FACE_SH, 1)
    local smile = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = smiley})
    New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile})
    New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile})
    New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 14), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile}).Rotation = 180
    local fbtn = button(gwBody, "flag: off", UDim2.fromOffset(78, 20), UDim2.new(0, vw * cs + 2 - 78, 0, 26), function(b)
        flagMode = not flagMode
        b.Text = flagMode and "flag: on" or "flag: off"
        b:SetAttribute("sel", flagMode)
        b:SetAttribute("base", flagMode and Color3.fromRGB(150, 120, 50) or nil)
        Tween(b, TWEEN_FAST, {BackgroundColor3 = flagMode and Color3.fromRGB(150, 120, 50) or PAL.card2})
    end, "ghost", nil, 9)
    local board = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vw * cs, vw * cs), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 26), BackgroundColor3 = C_FIELD, Parent = gwBody})
    corner(board, 4); stroke(board, C_FACE_SH, 1)
    local pool = {}

    local function drawFlag(cell)
        local s = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Name = "Sprite", Parent = cell})
        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 10), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 44), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = s})
        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 13), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 44), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = s})
        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 60, 60), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = s})
        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = s})
    end
    local function drawMine(cell, boom)
        local s = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Name = "Sprite", Parent = cell})
        local col = boom and Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34)
        for _, sp in ipairs({{2, 8, 14, 2}, {8, 2, 2, 14}, {4, 4, 10, 10}}) do
            New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sp[3], sp[4]), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp[1], sp[2]), BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = s})
        end
        local body = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundColor3 = col, Parent = s})
        corner(body, 5)
        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 234, 240), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = s}).Rotation = 45
    end
    local function render()
        for j = 0, vw - 1 do
            for i = 0, vw - 1 do
                local b = pool[j * vw + i + 1]
                local gx, gy = ox + i, oy + j
                local idx = gy * n + gx + 1
                local st = g.st[idx]
                for _, ch in ipairs(b:GetChildren()) do if ch.Name == "Sprite" or ch.Name == "Bevel" then ch:Destroy() end end
                if st == 1 then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = C_SUNK
                    if g.mine[idx] then
                        drawMine(b, g.dead and g.boom == idx)
                    else
                        local k = g.cnt[idx]
                        b.Text = k > 0 and tostring(k) or ""
                        b.TextColor3 = NUMCOL[k] or PAL.text
                    end
                elseif st == 2 then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = C_FACE
                    drawFlag(b)
                else
                    if g.dead and g.mine[idx] then
                        b.BackgroundColor3 = C_SUNK
                        drawMine(b, false)
                    else
                        b.Text = ""
                        b.BackgroundColor3 = C_FACE

                        local bev = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Name = "Bevel", Parent = b})
                        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 2), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C_FACE_HI, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bev})
                        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -2), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C_FACE_HI, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bev})
                        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -2), BackgroundColor3 = C_FACE_SH, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bev})
                        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C_FACE_SH, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bev})
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        ledML.Text = string.format("%03d", math.max(g.mines - g.flags, -99))
        ledTL.Text = string.format("%03d", math.min(finished and myRes.time or math.floor(os.clock() - t0), 999))
    end
    local function elapsed() return math.floor(os.clock() - t0) end
    local function resolve()
        if not myRes or not ses then return end
        if myRes.ok and not oppRes then setStatus("cleared! waiting for opponent...", PAL.good); return end
        if not oppRes then return end
        local win
        if myRes.ok and not oppRes.ok then win = true
        elseif oppRes.ok and not myRes.ok then win = false
        elseif myRes.ok and oppRes.ok then win = myRes.time <= oppRes.time
        else win = myRes.rev >= oppRes.rev end
        setStatus(win and "you win!" or "you lose", win and PAL.good or PAL.bad)
    end
    local function setFace(kind)
        for _, ch in ipairs(smile:GetChildren()) do ch:Destroy() end
        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile})
        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile})
        if kind == "dead" then
            New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile}).Rotation = 45
            New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 14), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile})
        elseif kind == "cool" then
            New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile})
            New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 14), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile})
        elseif kind == "worried" then
            New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 13), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile}).Rotation = 180
        else
            New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 14), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = smile}).Rotation = 180
        end
    end
    local function finish(ok)
        if finished then return end
        finished = true
        myRes = {ok = ok, time = elapsed(), rev = g.revealed}
        setFace(ok and "cool" or "dead")
        if ses then NET.send(ses, {t = "fin", ok = ok, time = myRes.time, rev = g.revealed}) end
        if not ses then setStatus(ok and ("cleared in " .. myRes.time .. "s!") or "boom! you hit a mine", ok and PAL.good or PAL.bad)
        else
            if not ok then setStatus("boom! waiting for result...", PAL.bad) end
            resolve()
        end
    end
    local function act(i, j, right)
        if finished then return end
        local gx, gy = ox + i, oy + j
        local idx = gy * n + gx + 1
        if right or flagMode then MS.flag(g, gx, gy)
        elseif g.st[idx] == 1 then MS.chord(g, gx, gy)
        else MS.reveal(g, gx, gy) end
        render()
        if not finished and not g.dead and not g.won then setFace("worried") task.delay(0.35, function() if not finished then setFace("smile") end end) end
        if g.dead then finish(false) elseif g.won then finish(true) end
    end
    for j = 0, vw - 1 do
        for i = 0, vw - 1 do
            local b = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 1, cs - 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(i * cs, j * cs), BackgroundColor3 = C_FACE, Text = "", TextSize = 11, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = PAL.text, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = board})
            corner(b, 2)
            Connect(b.MouseButton1Click, function() act(i, j, false) end)
            Connect(b.MouseButton2Click, function() act(i, j, true) end)
            pool[j * vw + i + 1] = b
        end
    end
    Connect(smiley.MouseButton1Click, function()
        if ses then return end
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
        MG.start("ms", diff, nil)
    end)
    local pad = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26 + vw * cs + 6), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = gwBody})
    local step = math.max(1, math.floor(vw / 2))
    local coord = txt(pad, "", UDim2.new(1, -130, 1, 0), nil, 9, PAL.dim)
    local function pan(dx, dy)
        ox = math.clamp(ox + dx * step, 0, n - vw); oy = math.clamp(oy + dy * step, 0, n - vw)
        coord.Text = n > vw and string.format("view  x %d-%d   y %d-%d", ox + 1, ox + vw, oy + 1, oy + vw) or ""
        render()
    end
    if n > vw then
        local px = vw * cs + 2
        button(pad, "<", UDim2.fromOffset(28, 22), UDim2.fromOffset(px - 120, 0), function() pan(-1, 0) end, "ghost", nil, 11)
        button(pad, "^", UDim2.fromOffset(28, 22), UDim2.fromOffset(px - 90, 0), function() pan(0, -1) end, "ghost", nil, 11)
        button(pad, "v", UDim2.fromOffset(28, 22), UDim2.fromOffset(px - 60, 0), function() pan(0, 1) end, "ghost", nil, 11)
        button(pad, ">", UDim2.fromOffset(28, 22), UDim2.fromOffset(px - 30, 0), function() pan(1, 0) end, "ghost", nil, 11)
    end
    pan(0, 0)
    local alive = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while alive and not MG.dead do
            ledML.Text = string.format("%03d", math.max(g.mines - g.flags, -99))
            ledTL.Text = string.format("%03d", math.min(finished and myRes.time or elapsed(), 999))
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
    local ctl = {ses = ses, destroy = function() alive = false end}
    if ses then
        ctl.onNet = function(m)
            if m.t == "fin" then
                oppRes = {ok = m.ok, time = m.time or 0, rev = m.rev or 0}
                if not myRes then setStatus(m.ok and "opponent cleared the board!" or "opponent hit a mine", PAL.warn) end
                resolve()
            elseif m.t == "quit" then
                oppRes = {ok = false, time = 0, rev = 0}
                if not finished then setStatus("opponent left - you win", PAL.good); finished = true end
            end
        end
        setStatus("race! same board - clear it before the opponent", PAL.dim)
    else
        setStatus("left click: open   right click: flag   smiley: restart", PAL.dim)
    end
    return ctl
end

local function pixels(parent, rows, pal, px, x, y)
    local w = 0
    for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if #r > w then w = #r end end
    local f = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * px, #rows * px), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x or 0, y or 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = parent})
    for r = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[r]
        local c = 1
        while c <= #row do
            local ch = string.sub(row, c, c)
            if ch ~= "." and pal[ch] then
                local e = c
                while e < #row and string.sub(row, e + 1, e + 1) == ch do e = e + 1 end
                New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset((e - c + 1) * px, px), Position = UDim2.fromOffset((c - 1) * px, (r - 1) * px), BackgroundColor3 = pal[ch], BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = f})
                c = e + 1
            else c = c + 1 end
        end
    end
    return f, w * px, #rows * px
end
local function tweenTo(o, t, props, style) Tween(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props) end

local TSIZE = {{3, 3}, {3, 3}, {3, 3}, {3, 3}}
local C_X, C_O = Color3.fromRGB(255, 118, 128), Color3.fromRGB(100, 170, 255)
local C_HID = Color3.fromRGB(52, 36, 21)
local C_HID_ALT = C_HID
local TSTATS = {w = 0, l = 0, d = 0}

local C4_RED, C4_YEL = Color3.fromRGB(224, 54, 62), Color3.fromRGB(240, 196, 48)
local FSTATS = {w = 0, l = 0, d = 0}
function MG.ttt(diff, ses)
    local n, k = TSIZE[diff][1], TSIZE[diff][2]
    local cs = 72
    local b = TT.new(n)
    local rng = LG.RNG(os.time() + math.random(1, 9999))
    local mySide = (ses and ses.role == "guest") and 2 or 1
    local turn, over, alive, lastCell = 1, false, true, nil
    local TURN_TIME = 10
    local turnEnd = nil
    local TOP = 28
    setContent(n * cs + 4, n * cs + TOP + 38)
    setTitle("Tic Tac Toe " .. n .. "x" .. n .. "  /  " .. k .. " in a row", diff, ses and ses.opp, ACC.ttt)

    local function chip(x, w, col)
        local f = box(gwBody, UDim2.fromOffset(w, 22), UDim2.fromOffset(x, 0), PAL.card2, 11)
        stroke(f, col, 1, 0.55)
        return txt(f, "", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), nil, 10, col, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
    end
    local bw = n * cs + 4
    local cw = math.floor((bw - 8) / 3)
    local youL = chip(0, cw, mySide == 1 and C_X or C_O)
    local drawL = chip(cw + 4, cw, PAL.dim)
    local oppL = chip((cw + 4) * 2, cw, mySide == 1 and C_O or C_X)
    local function score()
        local opp = ses and "OPP" or "BOT"
        youL.Text = "YOU " .. (mySide == 1 and "X" or "O") .. "  " .. (ses and "" or TSTATS.w)
        drawL.Text = "DRAWS  " .. (ses and "" or TSTATS.d)
        oppL.Text = opp .. " " .. (mySide == 1 and "O" or "X") .. "  " .. (ses and "" or TSTATS.l)
    end
    score()
    local board = box(gwBody, UDim2.fromOffset(n * cs + 4, n * cs + 4), UDim2.fromOffset(0, TOP), PAL.bg, 10)
    stroke(board, PAL.line)

    board.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 62, 34)
    local woodGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    woodGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(122, 82, 44), Color3.fromRGB(74, 47, 24))
    woodGrad.Rotation = 65
    woodGrad.Parent = board
    local grainRng = LG.RNG(77)
    for gi = 1, 7 do
        local gy2 = 6 + (gi - 1) * (n * cs + 4) / 7 + (grainRng(9) - 5)
        New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, gy2), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 30, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 0.55, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = board}).Rotation = grainRng() * 3 - 1.5
    end
    local cells, marks = {}, {}
    local th = math.max(3, math.floor(cs * 0.09))
    local function mkMark(parent, side, ghost)
        local m = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = parent})
        local sc = New("UIScale", {Scale = ghost and 1 or 0.2, Parent = m})
        local tr = ghost and 0.65 or 0
        if side == 1 then
            local len = math.floor(cs * 0.6)
            for _, rot in ipairs({45, -45}) do
                local bar = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = ghost and UDim2.fromOffset(len, th) or UDim2.fromOffset(0, th), Rotation = rot, BackgroundColor3 = C_X, BackgroundTransparency = tr, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = m})
                corner(bar, th)
                if not ghost then

                    Tween(bar, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, th)})
                end
            end
        else
            local d = math.floor(cs * 0.52)
            local ring = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = m})
            corner(ring, d); stroke(ring, C_O, th, tr)
            if not ghost then

                ring.Rotation = 220
                Tween(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Rotation = 0})
            end
        end
        if not ghost then tweenTo(sc, 0.22, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end
        return m
    end
    local function status()
        if over then return end
        if turn == mySide then
            if ses then turnEnd = os.clock() + TURN_TIME end
            setStatus("your turn  (" .. (mySide == 1 and "X" or "O") .. ")", mySide == 1 and C_X or C_O)
        else
            turnEnd = nil
            setStatus(ses and "opponent's turn..." or "bot is thinking...", PAL.dim)
        end
    end
    local function winLine(line)

        for _, i in ipairs(line) do
            local cell = cells[i]
            if cell then
                Tween(cell, TWEEN_FAST, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 118, 66)})
                local g = cell:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                if g then g.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(84, 176, 104), Color3.fromRGB(28, 78, 44)) end
                stroke(cell, PAL.good, 1.2, 0.1)
            end
        end
        local function center(i) local x, y = (i - 1) % n, math.floor((i - 1) / n); return Vector2.new(2 + x * cs + (cs - 3) / 2, 2 + y * cs + (cs - 3) / 2) end

        local a, c, best = center(line[1]), center(line[#line]), -1
        for p = 1, #line - 1 do for q = p + 1, #line do
            local pa, pc = center(line[p]), center(line[q])
            local d = (pa - pc).Magnitude
            if d > best then best = d; a, c = pa, pc end
        end end
        local mid = (a + c) / 2
        local len = (c - a).Magnitude + cs * 0.9
        local bar = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mid.X, mid.Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 5), Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(c.Y - a.Y, c.X - a.X)), BackgroundColor3 = PAL.good, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8, Parent = board})
        corner(bar, 3)
        tweenTo(bar, 0.35, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 5)})
        local shine = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mid.X, mid.Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 11), Rotation = bar.Rotation, BackgroundColor3 = PAL.good, BackgroundTransparency = 0.8, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 7, Parent = board})
        corner(shine, 5)
        tweenTo(shine, 0.4, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 11), BackgroundTransparency = 0.94})
    end
    local function endGame(winner, x, y)
        over = true
        if winner then
            local line = TT.winLine(b, n, k, x, y)
            if line then winLine(line) end
            local me = winner == mySide
            setStatus(me and "you win!" or "you lose", me and PAL.good or PAL.bad)
            if not ses then if me then TSTATS.w = TSTATS.w + 1 else TSTATS.l = TSTATS.l + 1 end end
        else
            setStatus("draw", PAL.warn)
            if not ses then TSTATS.d = TSTATS.d + 1 end
        end
        score()
    end
    local function place(x, y, side)
        local i = y * n + x + 1
        if b[i] ~= 0 or over then return false end
        b[i] = side
        local cell = cells[i]
        for _, ch in ipairs(cell:GetChildren()) do if ch.Name == "Ghost" then ch:Destroy() end end
        marks[i] = mkMark(cell, side, false)
        if lastCell and cells[lastCell] then
            for _, ch in ipairs(cells[lastCell]:GetChildren()) do if ch.Name == "Last" then ch:Destroy() end end
        end
        lastCell = i
        local ls = stroke(cell, side == 1 and C_X or C_O, 1, 0.35); ls.Name = "Last"
        cell.BackgroundColor3 = C_HID_ALT
        if TT.wins(b, n, k, x, y) then endGame(side, x, y)
        elseif TT.full(b) then endGame(nil)
        else turn = side == 1 and 2 or 1; status() end
        return true
    end
    local function botMove()
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.4)
            if not alive or over or turn == mySide then return end
            local x, y = TT.bot(b, n, k, 2, diff, rng)
            place(x, y, 2)
        end)
    end
    for y = 0, n - 1 do for x = 0, n - 1 do
        local i = y * n + x + 1

        local c = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 3, cs - 3), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2 + x * cs, 2 + y * cs), BackgroundColor3 = C_HID, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = board})
        corner(c, math.max(5, math.floor(cs / 6)))
        local tileGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        tileGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(64, 44, 26), Color3.fromRGB(42, 28, 15))
        tileGrad.Rotation = 90
        tileGrad.Parent = c
        Connect(c.MouseEnter, function()
            if b[i] == 0 and not over and turn == mySide then
                Tween(c, TWEEN_FAST, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 62, 36)})
                local g = mkMark(c, mySide, true); g.Name = "Ghost"
            end
        end)
        Connect(c.MouseLeave, function()
            for _, ch in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do if ch.Name == "Ghost" then ch:Destroy() end end
            if b[i] == 0 and not over then Tween(c, TWEEN_FAST, {BackgroundColor3 = C_HID}) end
        end)
        Connect(c.MouseButton1Click, function()
            if over or turn ~= mySide or b[i] ~= 0 then return end
            place(x, y, mySide)
            if ses then NET.send(ses, {t = "m", x = x, y = y})
            elseif not over then botMove() end
        end)
        cells[i] = c
    end end
    local ctl = {ses = ses, destroy = function() alive = false end}
    if ses then
        ctl.onNet = function(m)
            if m.t == "m" and type(m.x) == "number" and type(m.y) == "number" then
                if turn ~= mySide and not over then place(m.x, m.y, mySide == 1 and 2 or 1) end
            elseif m.t == "quit" and not over then over = true; setStatus("opponent left - you win", PAL.good) end
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            while alive and not MG.dead do
                task.wait(0.25)
                if not over and turn == mySide and turnEnd then
                    local leftT = turnEnd - os.clock()
                    if leftT <= 0 then
                        turnEnd = nil
                        local x, y = TT.bot(b, n, k, mySide, 2, rng)
                        place(x, y, mySide)
                        NET.send(ses, {t = "m", x = x, y = y})
                    else
                        setStatus(string.format("your turn  (%ds)", math.ceil(leftT)), mySide == 1 and C_X or C_O)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        button(gwBody, "new game", UDim2.fromOffset(92, 24), UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, TOP + n * cs + 8), function() MG.start("ttt", diff) end, "primary", ACC.ttt, 10)
    end
    status()
    return ctl
end

function MG.four(diff, ses)
    local W, H = C4.W, C4.H
    local cs = 44
    local b = {}
    for i = 1, W * H do b[i] = 0 end
    local rng = LG.RNG(os.time() + math.random(1, 9999))
    local mySide = (ses and ses.role == "guest") and 2 or 1
    local turn, over, alive = 1, false, true
    local TURN_TIME = 10
    local turnEnd = nil
    local TOP = 28
    local bw = W * cs + 4
    setContent(bw + 4, H * cs + TOP + 40)
    setTitle("4 In A Row", diff, ses and ses.opp, ACC.four)

    local function chip(x, w, col)
        local f = box(gwBody, UDim2.fromOffset(w, 22), UDim2.fromOffset(x, 0), PAL.card2, 11)
        stroke(f, col, 1, 0.55)
        return txt(f, "", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), nil, 10, col, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
    end
    local cw = math.floor((bw - 8) / 3)
    local youL = chip(0, cw, mySide == 1 and C4_RED or C4_YEL)
    local drawL = chip(cw + 4, cw, PAL.dim)
    local oppL = chip((cw + 4) * 2, cw, mySide == 1 and C4_YEL or C4_RED)
    local function score()
        local opp = ses and "OPP" or "BOT"
        youL.Text = "YOU  " .. (ses and "" or FSTATS.w)
        drawL.Text = "DRAWS  " .. (ses and "" or FSTATS.d)
        oppL.Text = opp .. "  " .. (ses and "" or FSTATS.l)
    end
    score()

    local board = box(gwBody, UDim2.fromOffset(bw + 8, H * cs + 12), UDim2.fromOffset(-2, TOP), Color3.fromRGB(58, 40, 22), 12)
    stroke(board, Color3.fromRGB(36, 24, 12), 1.5)
    local grid = box(board, UDim2.fromOffset(bw + 2, H * cs + 2), UDim2.fromOffset(3, 5), Color3.fromRGB(18, 52, 148), 10)
    local gridGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    gridGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(24, 66, 176), Color3.fromRGB(14, 40, 118))
    gridGrad.Rotation = 90
    gridGrad.Parent = grid

    local holes = {}
    for y = 0, H - 1 do for x = 0, W - 1 do
        local hole = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4 + x * cs + cs / 2, 4 + (H - 1 - y) * cs + cs / 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 8, cs - 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 22, 66), Parent = grid})
        corner(hole, math.floor((cs - 8) / 2))
        local rim = New("UIGradient")
        rim.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(24, 52, 132), Color3.fromRGB(6, 14, 44))
        rim.Rotation = 90
        rim.Parent = hole
        holes[y * W + x + 1] = hole
    end end

    local function mkDisc(parent, side, cx, cy, ghost)
        local d = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy), Size = ghost and UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 8, cs - 8) or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = side == 1 and C4_RED or C4_YEL, Parent = parent})
        corner(d, math.floor((cs - 8) / 2))
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new(side == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 118, 118) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 110), side == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(178, 34, 42) or Color3.fromRGB(206, 156, 30))
        g.Rotation = 115
        g.Parent = d
        stroke(d, Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14), 1, 0.35)

        local ring = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs * 0.44, cs * 0.44), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = d})
        corner(ring, math.floor(cs * 0.22))
        stroke(ring, side == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(120, 16, 24) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 118, 12), 2, ghost and 0.7 or 0.35)
        if not ghost then tweenTo(d, 0.24, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 8, cs - 8)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end
        return d
    end

    local function cellPos(x, y)
        return 4 + x * cs + cs / 2, 4 + (H - 1 - y) * cs + cs / 2
    end
    local function winLine(line)

        for _, i in ipairs(line) do
            local h = holes[i]
            if h then
                Tween(h, TWEEN_FAST, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 118, 66)})
                local gx = New("UIGradient"); gx.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(84, 176, 104), Color3.fromRGB(28, 78, 44)); gx.Rotation = 90; gx.Parent = h
            end
        end

        local function centerOf(i) local x, y = (i - 1) % W, math.floor((i - 1) / W); return Vector2.new(cellPos(x, y)) end
        local a, c, best = centerOf(line[1]), centerOf(line[1]), -1
        for p = 1, #line - 1 do for q = p + 1, #line do
            local pa, pc = centerOf(line[p]), centerOf(line[q])
            local d = (pa - pc).Magnitude
            if d > best then best = d; a, c = pa, pc end
        end end
        local mid = (a + c) / 2
        local len = (c - a).Magnitude + cs * 0.8
        local bar = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mid.X, mid.Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 7), Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(c.Y - a.Y, c.X - a.X)), BackgroundColor3 = PAL.good, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = grid})
        corner(bar, 4)
        tweenTo(bar, 0.35, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 7)})
        local shine = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mid.X, mid.Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 15), Rotation = bar.Rotation, BackgroundColor3 = PAL.good, BackgroundTransparency = 0.8, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8, Parent = grid})
        corner(shine, 7)
        tweenTo(shine, 0.4, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 15), BackgroundTransparency = 0.94})
    end
    local function status()
        if over then return end
        if turn == mySide then
            if ses then turnEnd = os.clock() + TURN_TIME end
            setStatus("your turn  (drop a " .. (mySide == 1 and "red" or "yellow") .. " disc)", mySide == 1 and C4_RED or C4_YEL)
        else
            turnEnd = nil
            setStatus(ses and "opponent's turn..." or "bot is thinking...", PAL.dim)
        end
    end
    local function endGame(winner, wx, wy)
        over = true
        if winner then
            local line = C4.winLine(b, wx, wy)
            if line then winLine(line) end
            local me = winner == mySide
            setStatus(me and "you win!" or "you lose", me and PAL.good or PAL.bad)
            if not ses then if me then FSTATS.w = FSTATS.w + 1 else FSTATS.l = FSTATS.l + 1 end end
        else
            setStatus("draw - board is full", PAL.warn)
            if not ses then FSTATS.d = FSTATS.d + 1 end
        end
        score()
    end

    local ghost = nil
    local ghostCol = nil
    local function clearGhost()
        if ghost then ghost:Destroy(); ghost = nil end
        ghostCol = nil
    end
    local function showGhost(x)
        if over or turn ~= mySide then return end
        local y = C4.landing(b, x)
        if not y then return end
        if ghostCol ~= x or not ghost or not ghost.Parent then
            clearGhost()
            local gx, gy = cellPos(x, H)
            ghost = mkDisc(grid, mySide, gx, gy - cs * 0.45, true)
            ghostCol = x
        end
    end
    local function place(x, side, animate)
        if over then return false end
        local y = C4.drop(b, x, side)
        if not y then return false end
        local cx, cy = cellPos(x, y)
        local d = mkDisc(grid, side, cx, cy - cs * 1.6, false)

        tweenTo(d, 0.16 + 0.045 * (H - 1 - y), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce)
        clearGhost()
        if C4.winLine(b, x, y) then endGame(side, x, y)
        elseif C4.full(b) then endGame(nil)
        else turn = side == 1 and 2 or 1; status() end
        return true
    end
    local function botMove()
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.45)
            if not alive or over or turn == mySide then return end
            local x = C4.bot(b, mySide == 1 and 2 or 1, diff, rng)
            place(x, mySide == 1 and 2 or 1)
        end)
    end

    for x = 0, W - 1 do
        local hit = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs, H * cs), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4 + x * cs, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = grid})
        Connect(hit.MouseEnter, function() if not over and turn == mySide and C4.landing(b, x) then showGhost(x) end end)
        Connect(hit.MouseLeave, function() if ghostCol == x then clearGhost() end end)
        Connect(hit.MouseButton1Click, function()
            if over or turn ~= mySide or not C4.landing(b, x) then return end
            place(x, mySide)
            if ses then NET.send(ses, {t = "m", x = x})
            elseif not over then botMove() end
        end)
    end
    local ctl = {ses = ses, destroy = function() alive = false end}
    if ses then
        ctl.onNet = function(m)
            if m.t == "m" and type(m.x) == "number" and m.x >= 0 and m.x < W then
                if turn ~= mySide and not over then place(m.x, mySide == 1 and 2 or 1) end
            elseif m.t == "quit" and not over then over = true; setStatus("opponent left - you win", PAL.good) end
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            while alive and not MG.dead do
                task.wait(0.25)
                if not over and turn == mySide and turnEnd then
                    local leftT = turnEnd - os.clock()
                    if leftT <= 0 then
                        turnEnd = nil
                        local x = C4.bot(b, mySide, 2, rng)
                        place(x, mySide)
                        NET.send(ses, {t = "m", x = x})
                    else
                        setStatus(string.format("your turn  (%ds)", math.ceil(leftT)), mySide == 1 and C4_RED or C4_YEL)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        button(gwBody, "new game", UDim2.fromOffset(92, 24), UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, TOP + H * cs + 10), function() MG.start("four", diff) end, "primary", ACC.four, 10)
    end
    status()
    return ctl
end

local C_WATER, C_MISS, C_HIT, C_SUNK, C_SHIP, C_PEND = Color3.fromRGB(24, 40, 66), Color3.fromRGB(46, 70, 104), Color3.fromRGB(232, 122, 52), Color3.fromRGB(190, 56, 68), Color3.fromRGB(104, 122, 152), Color3.fromRGB(200, 190, 90)
local SHIPTYPES = {{len = 4, name = "Battleship", count = 1}, {len = 3, name = "Cruiser", count = 2}, {len = 2, name = "Destroyer", count = 3}, {len = 1, name = "Boat", count = 4}}
local SHIPNAME = {[4] = "Battleship", [3] = "Cruiser", [2] = "Destroyer", [1] = "Boat"}
function MG.battleship(diff, ses)
    local N = BS.N
    local cs = 18
    local rng = LG.RNG(os.time() + math.random(1, 99999))
    local me = {own = {}, ships = {}, shots = {}, left = 0}
    for i = 1, N * N do me.own[i] = 0 end
    local nextSid = 1
    local left = {[4] = 1, [3] = 2, [2] = 3, [1] = 4}
    local selLen, horiz = 4, true
    local known = {}
    for i = 1, N * N do known[i] = 0 end
    local enemyLeft = {[4] = 1, [3] = 2, [2] = 3, [1] = 4}
    local bot, ai
    if not ses then bot = BS.place(rng); ai = BS.ai() end
    local phase, myTurn, over, alive = "place", false, false, true
    local TURN_TIME = 10
    local turnEnd = nil
    local readyMe, readyOpp = false, false
    local bh = 11 + N * cs
    local SIDE = 118
    setContent(bh + 8 + SIDE, 15 + bh + 17 + bh + 8)
    setTitle("Battleship", diff, ses and ses.opp, ACC.bs)
    local function axes(parent)
        for i = 0, N - 1 do
            txt(parent, tostring(i + 1), UDim2.fromOffset(cs, 10), UDim2.fromOffset(11 + i * cs, 0), 8, PAL.dim, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
            txt(parent, string.sub("ABCDEFGHIJ", i + 1, i + 1), UDim2.fromOffset(10, cs), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 11 + i * cs), 8, PAL.dim, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
        end
    end
    txt(gwBody, "ENEMY WATERS", UDim2.fromOffset(bh, 12), nil, 9, ACC.bs, nil, true)
    local eHold = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bh, bh), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 15), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = gwBody}); axes(eHold)
    txt(gwBody, "YOUR FLEET", UDim2.fromOffset(bh, 12), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 15 + bh + 2), 9, PAL.dim, nil, true)
    local mHold = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bh, bh), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 15 + bh + 17), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = gwBody}); axes(mHold)
    local ec, mc = {}, {}
    local paintMine, paintEnemy, status, sideRefresh

    local shipLayer = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bh, bh), Position = mHold.Position, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3, Parent = gwBody})
    local fxLayerE = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bh, bh), Position = eHold.Position, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 6, Parent = gwBody})
    local fxLayerM = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bh, bh), Position = mHold.Position, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 6, Parent = gwBody})
    local rebuildShips
    local function shipFx(idx, kind, layer)
        local x, y = (idx - 1) % N, math.floor((idx - 1) / N)
        local cx, cy = 11 + x * cs + cs / 2, 11 + y * cs + cs / 2
        local fx = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs, cs), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx - cs / 2, cy - cs / 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 7, Parent = layer})
        if kind == "miss" then
            local ring = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = fx})
            corner(ring, cs); stroke(ring, Color3.fromRGB(210, 228, 250), 2)
            tweenTo(ring, 0.4, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 4, cs - 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
            Tween(stroke(ring, Color3.fromRGB(210, 228, 250), 2), TweenInfo.new(0.45), {Transparency = 1})
            local dot = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 245), Parent = fx})
            corner(dot, 2)
            Tween(dot, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
            task.delay(0.6, function() fx:Destroy() end)
        elseif kind == "hit" or kind == "sunk" then
            local flame = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60), Parent = fx})
            corner(flame, 3)
            for k = 1, 6 do
                local ang = (k / 6) * 6.2832
                local spark = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundColor3 = (k % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 50), Parent = fx})
                corner(spark, 1)
                task.delay(k * 0.012, function()
                    if fx.Parent then Tween(spark, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(ang) * cs * 0.7, 0.5, math.sin(ang) * cs * 0.7), BackgroundTransparency = 1}) end
                end)
            end
            Tween(flame, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 8, cs - 8), BackgroundTransparency = 0.2})
            if kind == "sunk" then
                for k = 1, 3 do
                    local sm = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.3 + k * 0.2, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 128), Parent = fx})
                    corner(sm, 3)
                    task.delay(0.15 + k * 0.1, function()
                        if fx.Parent then Tween(sm, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.3 + k * 0.2, 0.05), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1}) end
                    end)
                end
            end
            task.delay(1.4, function() fx:Destroy() end)
        end
    end

    local function allPlaced() for l = 1, 4 do if left[l] > 0 then return false end end return true end
    local function pickNextLen()
        if selLen and left[selLen] > 0 then return selLen end
        for _, t in ipairs(SHIPTYPES) do if left[t.len] > 0 then return t.len end end
        return nil
    end
    local function removeShip(sid)
        local sh = me.ships[sid]
        if not sh then return end
        for _, i in ipairs(sh.cells) do me.own[i] = 0 end
        left[sh.len] = left[sh.len] + 1
        me.ships[sid] = nil
        if rebuildShips then rebuildShips() end
        return sh.len
    end
    local function putShip(len, x, y, hor)
        local cells = BS.cellsFor(len, x, y, hor)
        if not cells or not BS.canPlace(me.own, cells) then return false end
        local sid = nextSid; nextSid = nextSid + 1
        for _, i in ipairs(cells) do me.own[i] = sid end
        me.ships[sid] = {len = len, cells = cells, hits = 0}
        left[len] = left[len] - 1
        if rebuildShips then rebuildShips() end
        return true
    end
    local function showPreview(x, y)
        paintMine()
        if phase ~= "place" or readyMe or not selLen or left[selLen] <= 0 then return end
        local cells = BS.cellsFor(selLen, x, y, horiz)
        local ok = cells and BS.canPlace(me.own, cells)
        local col = ok and Color3.fromRGB(70, 170, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 70, 80)
        for s = 0, selLen - 1 do
            local cx, cy = x + (horiz and s or 0), y + (horiz and 0 or s)
            if cx < N and cy < N then mc[cy * N + cx + 1].BackgroundColor3 = col end
        end
    end

    rebuildShips = function()
        for _, ch in ipairs(shipLayer:GetChildren()) do ch:Destroy() end
        for sid, sh in pairs(me.ships) do
            local minx, miny, maxx, maxy = N, N, -1, -1
            for _, i in ipairs(sh.cells) do
                local x, y = (i - 1) % N, math.floor((i - 1) / N)
                if x < minx then minx = x end; if x > maxx then maxx = x end
                if y < miny then miny = y end; if y > maxy then maxy = y end
            end
            local hor = maxx > minx
            local px = 11 + minx * cs + 2
            local py = 11 + miny * cs + 2
            local w = hor and ((maxx - minx + 1) * cs - 5) or (cs - 5)
            local h = hor and (cs - 5) or ((maxy - miny + 1) * cs - 5)
            local dmg = (sh.hits or 0)
            local hullCol = dmg >= sh.len and Color3.fromRGB(60, 62, 72) or Color3.fromRGB(96, 112, 142)
            local hull = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py), BackgroundColor3 = hullCol, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Parent = shipLayer})
            corner(hull, math.floor(math.min(w, h) / 2) + 2)
            local deck = New("Frame", {Size = hor and UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(6, w - 10), h - 6) or UDim2.fromOffset(w - 6, math.max(6, h - 10)), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 136, 164), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Parent = hull})
            corner(deck, 3)
            local bridge = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(5, math.min(w, h) - 10), math.max(4, math.min(w, h) - 12)), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(hor and 0.35 or 0.5, hor and 0.5 or 0.35), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(72, 84, 110), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Parent = hull})
            corner(bridge, 2)
            if dmg > 0 and dmg < sh.len then
                local fire = New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Position = UDim2.fromScale(hor and 0.65 or 0.5, hor and 0.5 or 0.65), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 60), ZIndex = 6, Parent = hull})
                corner(fire, 3)
            end
        end
    end

    function paintEnemy()
        for i = 1, N * N do
            local v, c = known[i], ec[i]
            if v == 0 then c.BackgroundColor3 = C_WATER; c.Text = ""
            elseif v == 4 then c.BackgroundColor3 = C_PEND; c.Text = ""
            elseif v == 1 then c.BackgroundColor3 = C_MISS; c.Text = "-"; c.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 195, 230)
            elseif v == 2 then c.BackgroundColor3 = C_HIT; c.Text = "x"; c.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            else c.BackgroundColor3 = C_SUNK; c.Text = "x"; c.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
        end
    end
    function paintMine()
        for i = 1, N * N do
            local sid, c = me.own[i], mc[i]
            local shot = me.shots[i]
            if shot == 2 then
                local sh = me.ships[sid]
                c.BackgroundColor3 = (sh and sh.hits >= sh.len) and C_SUNK or C_HIT
            elseif shot == 1 then c.BackgroundColor3 = C_MISS
            elseif sid ~= 0 then c.BackgroundColor3 = C_SHIP
            else c.BackgroundColor3 = c:GetAttribute("base") or C_WATER end
        end
    end

    local side = box(gwBody, UDim2.fromOffset(SIDE, 15 + bh + 17 + bh), UDim2.fromOffset(bh + 8, 0), PAL.bg, 8)
    stroke(side, PAL.line, 1, 0.3)
    txt(side, "FLEET", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 4), 9, ACC.bs, nil, true)
    local rows = {}
    for k, t in ipairs(SHIPTYPES) do
        local r = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 20 + (k - 1) * 34), BackgroundColor3 = PAL.card2, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = side})
        corner(r, 6)
        local so = stroke(r, PAL.line, 1, 0.4)
        txt(r, t.name, UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 12), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2), 8, PAL.text, nil, true)
        local cnt = txt(r, "", UDim2.fromOffset(28, 12), UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 2), 9, ACC.bs, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, true)
        local blocks = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(t.len * 7, 7), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = r})
        for s = 0, t.len - 1 do box(blocks, UDim2.fromOffset(6, 7), UDim2.fromOffset(s * 7, 0), C_SHIP, 1) end
        rows[t.len] = {btn = r, st = so, cnt = cnt, blocks = blocks}
        Connect(r.MouseButton1Click, function()
            if phase ~= "place" or readyMe then return end
            if left[t.len] > 0 then selLen = t.len; sideRefresh() end
        end)
    end
    local info = txt(side, "", UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 60), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 20 + 4 * 34), 8, PAL.dim)
    info.TextWrapped = true; info.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    function sideRefresh()
        for len, r in pairs(rows) do
            local on = selLen == len and phase == "place" and left[len] > 0
            r.st.Color = on and ACC.bs or PAL.line
            r.st.Transparency = on and 0 or 0.4
            if phase == "place" then
                r.cnt.Text = left[len] > 0 and ("x" .. left[len]) or "ok"
                local col = left[len] == 0 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 110) or C_SHIP
                for _, bl in ipairs(r.blocks:GetChildren()) do bl.BackgroundColor3 = col end
            else
                r.cnt.Text = "x" .. enemyLeft[len]
                for _, bl in ipairs(r.blocks:GetChildren()) do bl.BackgroundColor3 = enemyLeft[len] > 0 and C_SHIP or C_SUNK end
            end
        end
        if phase == "place" then
            info.Text = readyMe and "waiting for opponent..." or ("place: " .. (selLen and SHIPNAME[selLen] or "all done") .. " (" .. (horiz and "horizontal" or "vertical") .. "). R rotates. ships must not touch. click a ship to move it.")
        else
            local alive_ = 0
            for _, sh in pairs(me.ships) do if sh.hits < sh.len then alive_ = alive_ + 1 end end
            local en = 0
            for l = 1, 4 do en = en + enemyLeft[l] end
            info.Text = "your ships afloat: " .. alive_ .. "\nenemy ships afloat: " .. en .. "\n(right column = enemy fleet)"
        end
    end
    function status()
        if over then return end
        if phase == "place" then setStatus(readyMe and "waiting for opponent..." or (allPlaced() and "fleet ready - press start" or "place your ships (no touching)"), PAL.dim)
        elseif myTurn then
            if ses then turnEnd = os.clock() + TURN_TIME end
            setStatus("your turn - fire at enemy waters", PAL.text)
        else
            turnEnd = nil
            setStatus(ses and "opponent is aiming..." or "enemy is aiming...", PAL.dim)
        end
        sideRefresh()
    end
    local function lose() over = true; setStatus("your fleet is sunk - you lose", PAL.bad); sideRefresh() end
    local function win() over = true; setStatus("enemy fleet destroyed - you win!", PAL.good); sideRefresh() end
    local function botTurn()
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.6)
            if not alive or over then return end
            local idx = BS.aiShot(ai, diff, rng)
            local res, sid, done = BS.fire(me, idx)
            BS.aiResult(ai, idx, res, res == 2 and me.ships[sid].cells or nil)
            paintMine()
            rebuildShips()
            shipFx(idx, res == 0 and "miss" or (res == 2 and "sunk" or "hit"), fxLayerM)
            if res == 2 then setStatus("enemy sank your " .. SHIPNAME[me.ships[sid].len] .. "!", PAL.bad) elseif res == 1 then setStatus("enemy hit your ship!", PAL.warn) end
            if done then lose() return end
            task.wait(0.9)
            myTurn = true; status()
        end)
    end
    local function applyResult(idx, res, cells, over2)
        if res == 0 then known[idx] = 1
        elseif res == 1 then known[idx] = 2
        else
            local list = cells or {idx}
            for _, i in ipairs(list) do known[i] = 3 end
            for _, j in ipairs(BS.neighbors(list)) do if known[j] == 0 then known[j] = 1 end end
            local len = #list
            if enemyLeft[len] and enemyLeft[len] > 0 then enemyLeft[len] = enemyLeft[len] - 1 end
        end
        paintEnemy()

        if res == 0 then shipFx(idx, "miss", fxLayerE)
        else shipFx(idx, res == 2 and "sunk" or "hit", fxLayerE) end
        if res == 2 then setStatus("you sank a ship (" .. (cells and #cells or "?") .. ")!", PAL.good) elseif res == 1 then setStatus("hit!", PAL.warn) elseif res == 0 then setStatus("miss", PAL.dim) end
        sideRefresh()
        if over2 then win() end
    end
    local function fireAt(idx)
        if phase ~= "play" or not myTurn or over or known[idx] ~= 0 then return end
        myTurn = false
        if ses then
            known[idx] = 4
            paintEnemy()
            NET.send(ses, {t = "m", i = idx})
            status()
        else
            local res, sid, done = BS.fire(bot, idx)
            applyResult(idx, res, res == 2 and bot.ships[sid].cells or nil, done)
            if not over then task.delay(0.9, function() if alive and not over then botTurn() end end) end
        end
    end
    for y = 0, N - 1 do for x = 0, N - 1 do
        local i = y * N + x + 1

        local base = ((x + y) % 2 == 0) and C_WATER or Color3.fromRGB(21, 36, 58)
        local e = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 1, cs - 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11 + x * cs, 11 + y * cs), BackgroundColor3 = base, Text = "", TextSize = 11, Font = FONTB, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = eHold})
        e:SetAttribute("base", base)
        corner(e, 3)
        Connect(e.MouseEnter, function()
            if known[i] == 0 and phase == "play" and myTurn and not over then
                Tween(e, TWEEN_FAST, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 82, 128)})

                local xh = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Name = "XHair", ZIndex = 5, Parent = e})
                New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = xh})
                New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = xh})
            end
        end)
        Connect(e.MouseLeave, function()
            for _, ch in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do if ch.Name == "XHair" then ch:Destroy() end end
            if known[i] == 0 then Tween(e, TWEEN_FAST, {BackgroundColor3 = e:GetAttribute("base") or C_WATER}) end
        end)
        Connect(e.MouseButton1Click, function() fireAt(i) end)
        ec[i] = e
        local mbase = ((x + y) % 2 == 0) and C_WATER or Color3.fromRGB(21, 36, 58)
        local m = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs - 1, cs - 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11 + x * cs, 11 + y * cs), BackgroundColor3 = mbase, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = mHold})
        m:SetAttribute("base", mbase)
        corner(m, 3)
        Connect(m.MouseEnter, function() if phase == "place" and not readyMe then showPreview(x, y) end end)
        Connect(m.MouseLeave, function() if phase == "place" then paintMine() end end)
        Connect(m.MouseButton1Click, function()
            if phase ~= "place" or readyMe then return end
            local sid = me.own[i]
            if sid ~= 0 then
                local len = removeShip(sid)
                selLen = len; paintMine(); showPreview(x, y); status()
                return
            end
            if selLen and left[selLen] > 0 and putShip(selLen, x, y, horiz) then
                selLen = pickNextLen()
                paintMine(); status()
            end
        end)
        mc[i] = m
    end end
    Connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(inp)
        if not alive or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R and phase == "place" and not readyMe then horiz = not horiz; sideRefresh() end
    end)
    local function startPlay()
        phase = "play"
        me.left = #BS.FLEET
        for _, sh in pairs(me.ships) do sh.hits = 0 end
        myTurn = (not ses) or ses.role == "host"
        paintMine(); status()
    end
    local function sideBtn(label, y, cb, style, accent)
        return button(side, label, UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 22), UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, y), cb, style or "ghost", accent, 9)
    end
    local sy = 20 + 4 * 34 + 62
    sideBtn("rotate (R)", sy, function() if phase == "place" and not readyMe then horiz = not horiz; sideRefresh() end end)
    sideBtn("randomize", sy + 26, function()
        if phase ~= "place" or readyMe then return end
        local R = BS.place(rng)
        me = {own = R.own, ships = R.ships, shots = {}, left = 0}
        nextSid = #BS.FLEET + 1
        left = {[4] = 0, [3] = 0, [2] = 0, [1] = 0}
        selLen = nil; paintMine(); rebuildShips(); status()
    end)
    sideBtn("clear", sy + 52, function()
        if phase ~= "place" or readyMe then return end
        me = {own = {}, ships = {}, shots = {}, left = 0}
        for i = 1, N * N do me.own[i] = 0 end
        nextSid = 1; left = {[4] = 1, [3] = 2, [2] = 3, [1] = 4}; selLen = 4
        paintMine(); rebuildShips(); status()
    end)
    sideBtn(ses and "ready" or "start", sy + 78, function()
        if phase ~= "place" or readyMe then return end
        if not allPlaced() then setStatus("place all 10 ships first", PAL.warn); return end
        readyMe = true
        if ses then
            NET.send(ses, {t = "ready"})
            if readyOpp then startPlay() else status() end
        else startPlay() end
    end, "primary", ACC.bs)
    paintMine(); paintEnemy(); rebuildShips()

    local waves = {}
    for _, layer in ipairs({eHold, mHold}) do
        for k = 1, 2 do
            local wv = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 170, 220), BackgroundTransparency = 0.72, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Parent = layer})
            corner(wv, 2)
            waves[#waves + 1] = {f = wv, x = math.random(0, bh), y = math.random(12, bh - 12), sp = (10 + k * 7) * (layer == eHold and 1 or 0.8), layer = layer}
        end
    end
    local waveConn = Connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
        for _, wv in ipairs(waves) do
            wv.x = wv.x - wv.sp * dt
            if wv.x < -30 then wv.x = bh + 10; wv.y = math.random(12, bh - 12) end
            wv.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(wv.x), math.floor(wv.y))
        end
    end)
    local ctl = {ses = ses, destroy = function() alive = false; pcall(function() waveConn:Disconnect() end) end}
    if ses then
        ctl.onNet = function(m)
            if m.t == "ready" then readyOpp = true; if readyMe and phase == "place" then startPlay() end
            elseif m.t == "m" and type(m.i) == "number" and phase == "play" and not over then
                local res, sid, done = BS.fire(me, m.i)
                if res then
                    local cells = res == 2 and table.concat(me.ships[sid].cells, ",") or ""
                    NET.send(ses, {t = "r", i = m.i, res = res, cells = cells, over = done and true or false})
                    paintMine()
                    rebuildShips()
                    shipFx(m.i, res == 0 and "miss" or (res == 2 and "sunk" or "hit"), fxLayerM)
                    if done then lose() else myTurn = true; status() end
                end
            elseif m.t == "r" and type(m.i) == "number" then
                local cells
                if m.cells and m.cells ~= "" then cells = {}; for v in string.gmatch(m.cells, "%d+") do cells[#cells + 1] = tonumber(v) end end
                applyResult(m.i, m.res, cells, m.over)
                if not over then status() end
            elseif m.t == "quit" and not over then over = true; setStatus("opponent left - you win", PAL.good) end
        end
    end
    status()
    if ses then

        task.spawn(function()
            while alive and not MG.dead do
                task.wait(0.25)
                if not over and phase == "play" and myTurn and turnEnd then
                    local leftT = turnEnd - os.clock()
                    if leftT <= 0 then
                        turnEnd = nil
                        local rem = {}
                        for l = 1, 4 do for _ = 1, enemyLeft[l] do rem[#rem + 1] = l end end
                        local idx = BS.aiShot({ k = known, rem = rem }, 2, rng)
                        fireAt(idx)
                    else
                        setStatus(string.format("your turn  (%ds) - fire at enemy waters", math.ceil(leftT)), PAL.text)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    return ctl
end
