X.MG.dinoLB = {sessionBest = 0, lastSent = -1}
local function dinoMyBest()
    return math.max(tonumber(CFG.dinoHi) or 0, X.MG.dinoLB.sessionBest or 0)
end
local function dinoLBPush()
    local s = dinoMyBest()
    if s <= 0 then return end
    X.MG.dinoLB.lastSent = s
    NET.pub("DLB", {t = "lb", s = s})
    if GNET.hasHttp() then task.spawn(pcall, GNET.dinoPush, s) end
end
function X.MG.dinoLBCollect()
    local nowT = os.time()
    local map = {}
    map["u" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId)] = { name = LocalPlayer.Name, score = dinoMyBest(), me = true }
    for _, m in ipairs(NET.inbox["DLB"] or {}) do
        if m.t == "lb" and m.u and (m.s or 0) > 0 and nowT - (m._time or 0) < 120 and Players:FindFirstChild(m.u) then
            local e = map[m.u]
            if not e then e = { name = m.u, score = 0 }; map[m.u] = e end
            if (m.s or 0) > e.score then e.score = m.s end
        end
    end
    local arr = {}
    for _, e in pairs(map) do arr[#arr + 1] = e end
    table.sort(arr, function(a, b) return (a.score or 0) > (b.score or 0) end)
    return arr
end
function MG.dino(diff, ses)
    local W, H, GY = 340, 140, 118
    local rng = LG.RNG(ses and ses.seed or math.random(1, 2000000000))
    setContent(W + 2, H + 38)
    setTitle("Dino Run", diff, ses and ses.opp, ACC.dino)
    local world = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true, Parent = gwBody})
    corner(world, 8); stroke(world, PAL.line)
    local skyGrad = grad(world, Color3.fromRGB(96, 158, 224), Color3.fromRGB(186, 219, 240), 90)
    local FG, CACT, BIRD, CLOUDC = ACC.dino, Color3.fromRGB(74, 156, 92), Color3.fromRGB(232, 168, 88), Color3.fromRGB(240, 244, 252)

    local CPAL = { ["1"] = Color3.fromRGB(24, 48, 30), ["#"] = Color3.fromRGB(58, 112, 66), d = Color3.fromRGB(44, 86, 52), ["3"] = Color3.fromRGB(96, 160, 104), s = Color3.fromRGB(225, 232, 210), f = Color3.fromRGB(235, 120, 150), y = Color3.fromRGB(250, 210, 90) }
    local function blk(p, x, y, w, h, col) return New("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), BackgroundColor3 = col or FG, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = p}) end

    local starsHold = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = world})
    local starRng = LG.RNG(7)
    for _ = 1, 34 do
        local s = blk(starsHold, starRng(W) - 1, starRng(84) - 1, starRng(2), starRng(2), Color3.fromRGB(230, 236, 250))
        s.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + starRng() * 0.55
    end
    local sunHalo = blk(world, W - 74, 10, 32, 32, Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 170)); corner(sunHalo, 16); sunHalo.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
    local sunDisk = blk(world, W - 68, 16, 20, 20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 130)); corner(sunDisk, 10)
    local moonDisk = blk(world, W - 66, 14, 18, 18, Color3.fromRGB(226, 228, 240)); corner(moonDisk, 9); moonDisk.Visible = false
    local moonSpot = blk(world, W - 60, 20, 4, 4, Color3.fromRGB(206, 210, 226)); corner(moonSpot, 2); moonSpot.Visible = false
    local clouds = {}
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local hold = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(i * 110 - 40, 16 + (i % 2) * 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = world})
        local parts = {}
        for j, spec in ipairs({{0, 4, 30, 8}, {10, 0, 26, 10}, {26, 6, 22, 6}}) do
            local p = blk(hold, spec[1], spec[2], spec[3], spec[4], CLOUDC)
            corner(p, math.floor(spec[4] / 2))
            p.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
            parts[j] = p
        end
        clouds[i] = {f = hold, parts = parts, x = i * 110 - 40}
    end

    local hillRng = LG.RNG(31)
    local hills1, hills2 = {}, {}
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local w, h = 90 + hillRng(70), 34 + hillRng(22)
        local hf = blk(world, i * 95 - 60, GY - h + 8, w, h + 14, Color3.fromRGB(120, 156, 120))
        corner(hf, math.floor(w / 2))
        hills1[i] = {f = hf, x = i * 95 - 60, w = w}
    end
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local w, h = 70 + hillRng(50), 22 + hillRng(16)
        local hf = blk(world, i * 130 - 80, GY - h + 6, w, h + 12, Color3.fromRGB(96, 132, 100))
        corner(hf, math.floor(w / 2))
        hills2[i] = {f = hf, x = i * 130 - 80, w = w}
    end

    local groundTop = blk(world, 0, GY, W, 3, Color3.fromRGB(205, 180, 132))
    local groundFill = blk(world, 0, GY + 3, W, H - GY - 3, Color3.fromRGB(178, 152, 108))
    local dashes, pebbles = {}, {}
    for i = 1, 12 do dashes[i] = {f = blk(world, 0, GY + 7 + (i % 4) * 4, 6 + (i % 3) * 5, 2, Color3.fromRGB(160, 136, 96)), x = (i - 1) * 30 + (i * 7) % 22} end
    for i = 1, 10 do pebbles[i] = {f = blk(world, 0, GY + 4 + (i % 3) * 8, 3 + (i % 2), 2, Color3.fromRGB(146, 122, 88)), x = (i - 1) * 34 + (i * 13) % 26} end
    local hudBack = box(world, UDim2.fromOffset(126, 14), UDim2.new(1, -128, 0, 5), Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 20), 6)
    hudBack.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    local hud = txt(world, "", UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6), 10, PAL.text, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, true)
    local msg = txt(world, "press space / tap to start", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 44), 11, PAL.text, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
    msg.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6

    local lbBack = box(world, UDim2.fromOffset(120, 84), UDim2.new(1, -124, 0, 24), Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 24), 8)
    lbBack.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    local lbTitle = txt(lbBack, "online top - all roblox", UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 3), 8, PAL.dim, nil, true)
    local lbRows = {}
    for i = 1, 6 do
        lbRows[i] = txt(lbBack, "", UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 11), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 14 + (i - 1) * 11), 8, PAL.text)
    end
    local function renderLB()

        local map = {}
        local okG, garr = pcall(GNET.dinoTop)
        if okG and type(garr) == "table" then
            for _, e in ipairs(garr) do
                if (e.score or 0) > 0 then map[tostring(e.key)] = { name = e.name, score = e.score, key = e.key } end
            end
        end
        local okL, larr = pcall(X.MG.dinoLBCollect)
        if okL and type(larr) == "table" then
            for _, e in ipairs(larr) do
                local k = e.me and ("u" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId)) or ("s:" .. tostring(e.name))
                local cur = map[k]
                if not cur or (e.score or 0) > cur.score then map[k] = { name = e.name, score = e.score or 0, me = e.me, key = k } end
            end
        end
        local arr = {}
        for _, e in pairs(map) do arr[#arr + 1] = e end
        table.sort(arr, function(a, b) return (a.score or 0) > (b.score or 0) end)
        lbTitle.Text = (GNET.ok == false and GNET.fails > 2) and "online top - this server (global offline)" or "online top - all roblox"
        for i = 1, 6 do
            local e = arr[i]
            if e then
                local nm = tostring(e.name or "?")
                if #nm > 12 then nm = string.sub(nm, 1, 12) .. ".." end
                lbRows[i].Text = i .. ". " .. nm .. "  " .. tostring(e.score or 0)
                lbRows[i].TextColor3 = e.me and PAL.good or PAL.text
            else
                lbRows[i].Text = ""
            end
        end
    end
    renderLB()

    local SKIES = {
        {top = Color3.fromRGB(96, 158, 224), bot = Color3.fromRGB(186, 219, 240), hill1 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 156, 120), hill2 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 132, 100), ground = Color3.fromRGB(205, 180, 132), dirt = Color3.fromRGB(178, 152, 108), cloud = Color3.fromRGB(240, 244, 252), sunV = 1, moonV = 0, starV = 0},
        {top = Color3.fromRGB(86, 92, 148),  bot = Color3.fromRGB(238, 158, 106), hill1 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 108, 128), hill2 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 84, 106),  ground = Color3.fromRGB(196, 158, 118), dirt = Color3.fromRGB(160, 128, 94),  cloud = Color3.fromRGB(250, 200, 160), sunV = 0.65, moonV = 0.15, starV = 0.2},
        {top = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 32),   bot = Color3.fromRGB(46, 58, 92),    hill1 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 48, 72),    hill2 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 34, 56),    ground = Color3.fromRGB(72, 78, 100),   dirt = Color3.fromRGB(56, 62, 84),    cloud = Color3.fromRGB(70, 80, 110),   sunV = 0, moonV = 1, starV = 1},
        {top = Color3.fromRGB(74, 96, 150),  bot = Color3.fromRGB(240, 190, 170), hill1 = Color3.fromRGB(104, 122, 138), hill2 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 96, 118),   ground = Color3.fromRGB(198, 172, 138), dirt = Color3.fromRGB(166, 140, 112), cloud = Color3.fromRGB(246, 218, 206), sunV = 0.3, moonV = 0.4, starV = 0.2},
    }
    local SKY_SPAN = 150
    local function lerpC(a, b, t) return Color3.new(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * t, a.G + (b.G - a.G) * t, a.B + (b.B - a.B) * t) end
    local function lerpN(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
    local function smooth(t) return t * t * (3 - 2 * t) end
    local starList = {}
    for _, s in ipairs(starsHold:GetChildren()) do starList[#starList + 1] = { f = s, a = s.BackgroundTransparency } end
    local function applySky(phase)
        local n = #SKIES
        local i = math.floor(phase) % n
        local j = (i + 1) % n
        local t = smooth(phase - math.floor(phase))
        local a, b = SKIES[i + 1], SKIES[j + 1]
        pcall(function() skyGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(lerpC(a.top, b.top, t), lerpC(a.bot, b.bot, t)) end)
        local h1 = lerpC(a.hill1, b.hill1, t)
        local h2 = lerpC(a.hill2, b.hill2, t)
        local gr = lerpC(a.ground, b.ground, t)
        local dr = lerpC(a.dirt, b.dirt, t)
        local cl = lerpC(a.cloud, b.cloud, t)
        for _, h in ipairs(hills1) do h.f.BackgroundColor3 = h1 end
        for _, h in ipairs(hills2) do h.f.BackgroundColor3 = h2 end
        groundTop.BackgroundColor3 = gr
        groundFill.BackgroundColor3 = dr
        for _, dsh in ipairs(dashes) do dsh.f.BackgroundColor3 = dr end
        for _, pb in ipairs(pebbles) do pb.f.BackgroundColor3 = dr end
        for _, c in ipairs(clouds) do for _, p in ipairs(c.parts) do p.BackgroundColor3 = cl end end
        local sunV = lerpN(a.sunV, b.sunV, t)
        local moonV = lerpN(a.moonV, b.moonV, t)
        local starV = lerpN(a.starV, b.starV, t)
        sunDisk.Visible = sunV > 0.03; sunHalo.Visible = sunV > 0.03
        sunDisk.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - sunV, 0, 1)
        sunHalo.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - sunV * 0.55, 0.35, 1)
        moonDisk.Visible = moonV > 0.03; moonSpot.Visible = moonV > 0.03
        moonDisk.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - moonV, 0, 1)
        moonSpot.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - moonV * 0.8, 0, 1)
        starsHold.Visible = starV > 0.05
        for _, s in ipairs(starList) do s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - s.a) * starV end
    end
    applySky(0)

    local DX = 30
    local pal = { ["#"] = Color3.fromRGB(108, 206, 120), ["1"] = Color3.fromRGB(36, 74, 46), ["2"] = Color3.fromRGB(214, 246, 220), ["3"] = Color3.fromRGB(168, 238, 178), v = Color3.fromRGB(52, 110, 64), w = Color3.fromRGB(250, 252, 250), e = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 34), m = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 34), t = Color3.fromRGB(245, 250, 245) }
    local function cat(a, b) local r = {}; for _, v in ipairs(a) do r[#r + 1] = v end; for _, v in ipairs(b) do r[#r + 1] = v end; return r end
    local spr = {}
    spr.run1 = pixels(world, cat(DINO_BODY, LEG1), pal, 2, DX, GY - 44)
    spr.run2 = pixels(world, cat(DINO_BODY, LEG2), pal, 2, DX, GY - 44)
    spr.duck1 = pixels(world, DINO_DUCK, pal, 2, DX, GY - 26)
    spr.dead = pixels(world, cat(DINO_BODY, LEG1), { ["#"] = PAL.bad, ["1"] = Color3.fromRGB(120, 30, 34), w = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), e = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }, 2, DX, GY - 44)
    local shadow = blk(world, DX + 2, GY - 2, 46, 4, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))
    corner(shadow, 4)
    shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
    local function show(name) for k, f in pairs(spr) do f.Visible = (k == name) end end
    show("run1")
    local best = tonumber(CFG.dinoHi) or 0
    local st = {run = false, dead = false, y = 0, vy = 0, duck = false, travel = 0, nextSpawn = 380, obs = {}, last = os.clock(), score = 0, air = false}
    local oppScore, oppFin, myFin = nil, nil, false
    local alive = true
    local flashUntil = 0
    local function speedAt() return math.min(DMAX[diff], DBASE[diff] + st.travel * DRAMP[diff]) end
    local function dust(x)
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local d = blk(world, x + i * 4, GY - 4, 4, 4, PAL.dim)
            corner(d, 2)
            tweenTo(d, 0.35, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + i * 4 - 14 - i * 3, GY - 12 - i * 3), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
            task.delay(0.4, function() d:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    local function spawn()
        local sp = speedAt()
        local sc = math.floor(st.travel / 10)
        local o = {x = W + 20}
        local f = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = world})
        local bird = sc >= DBIRD[diff] and rng() < 0.28
        if bird then
            local lv = rng(3)
            o.w, o.h, o.kind = 28, 16, "bird"
            o.yb = ({0, 24, 46})[lv]
            o.s1 = pixels(f, BIRD_UP, {["#"] = BIRD}, 2, 0, 0)
            o.s2 = pixels(f, BIRD_DN, {["#"] = BIRD}, 2, 0, 0)
            o.s2.Visible = false
        else
            local r = rng(4)
            o.kind = "cactus"; o.yb = 0

            local cp = CPAL
            if r == 1 then o.w, o.h = 16, 26; pixels(f, CACT_S, cp, 2, 0, 0)
            elseif r == 2 then o.w, o.h = 16, 42; pixels(f, CACT_L, cp, 2, 0, 0)
            elseif r == 3 then o.w, o.h = 36, 26; pixels(f, CACT_S, cp, 2, 0, 0); pixels(f, CACT_S, cp, 2, 20, 0)
            else o.w, o.h = 36, 42; pixels(f, CACT_L, cp, 2, 0, 0); pixels(f, CACT_S, cp, 2, 20, 16) end
        end
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(o.w, o.h)
        f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(o.x, GY - o.yb - o.h)
        o.f = f
        st.obs[#st.obs + 1] = o
        st.nextSpawn = st.travel + sp * (0.62 + rng() * 0.6) + o.w
    end
    local function sendProgress(final)
        if ses then NET.send(ses, {t = final and "fin" or "p", s = st.score}) end
    end
    local function resolve()
        if not ses or not oppFin then return end
        if myFin then
            local w = st.score > oppScore
            setStatus(w and "you win!" or "you lose", w and PAL.good or PAL.bad)
        elseif st.run and st.score > oppScore then
            st.run = false; myFin = true
            msg.Text = "you win!"
            setStatus("you beat the opponent's score - you win!", PAL.good)
            sendProgress(true)
        end
    end
    local function die()
        st.dead = true; st.run = false; myFin = true
        show("dead")
        spr.dead.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(DX, GY - st.y - 44)
        msg.Text = "GAME OVER  -  space / tap to restart"
        if st.score > best then best = st.score; CFG.dinoHi = best; saveCFG() end
        if best > (X.MG.dinoLB.sessionBest or 0) then X.MG.dinoLB.sessionBest = best end
        pcall(dinoLBPush)
        renderLB()
        sendProgress(true)
        if ses then
            if oppFin then resolve() else setStatus("waiting for opponent to finish... (you: " .. st.score .. ")", PAL.dim) end
            msg.Text = "GAME OVER"
        end
    end
    local function reset()
        for _, o in ipairs(st.obs) do o.f:Destroy() end
        st.obs = {}; st.travel = 0; st.nextSpawn = 380; st.y = 0; st.vy = 0; st.dead = false; st.run = true; st.score = 0; st.duck = false
        msg.Text = ""
        rng = LG.RNG(ses and ses.seed or math.random(1, 2000000000))
        st.last = os.clock()
        show("run1")
    end
    local function jump()
        if not st.run and not st.dead then reset() return end
        if st.dead then if not ses then reset() end return end
        if st.y <= 0.5 then st.vy = 540 end
    end
    Connect(world.InputBegan, function(i) if IsPress(i) then jump() end end)
    Connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(i)
        if not alive or MG.cur == nil or MG.cur.kind ~= "dino" or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up or i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then jump()
        elseif i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down or i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then st.duck = true end
    end)
    Connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i)
        if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down or i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then st.duck = false end
    end)
    local duckBtn = button(gwBody, "duck (hold)", UDim2.fromOffset(110, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(1, H + 8), nil, "ghost", nil, 10)
    Connect(duckBtn.InputBegan, function(i) if IsPress(i) then st.duck = true end end)
    Connect(duckBtn.InputEnded, function(i) if IsPress(i) then st.duck = false end end)
    button(gwBody, "jump", UDim2.fromOffset(110, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(W - 109, H + 8), function() jump() end, "primary", ACC.dino, 10)
    local frame = 0
    local conn
    conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not alive or MG.dead then conn:Disconnect() return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local dt = math.min(now - st.last, 0.05); st.last = now
        local spNow = st.run and speedAt() or 0

        local envSp = st.run and spNow or 60
        for _, c in ipairs(clouds) do
            c.x = c.x - envSp * 0.08 * dt
            if c.x < -56 then c.x = W + 24 end
            c.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(c.x), c.f.Position.Y.Offset)
        end
        for _, h in ipairs(hills1) do
            h.x = h.x - envSp * 0.14 * dt
            if h.x < -h.w - 10 then h.x = W + 20 end
            h.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(h.x), h.f.Position.Y.Offset)
        end
        for _, h in ipairs(hills2) do
            h.x = h.x - envSp * 0.3 * dt
            if h.x < -h.w - 10 then h.x = W + 20 end
            h.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(h.x), h.f.Position.Y.Offset)
        end
        for _, pb in ipairs(pebbles) do
            pb.x = pb.x - (st.run and spNow or 0) * dt
            if pb.x < -8 then pb.x = pb.x + W + 40 end
            pb.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(pb.x + 0.5), pb.f.Position.Y.Offset)
        end

        pcall(function()
            local sw = math.max(6, 16 - st.y * 0.16)
            shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(sw), 4)
            shadow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.5 + st.y / 160, 0.5, 0.92)
        end)

        pcall(applySky, st.score / SKY_SPAN)
        if st.run and frame % 30 == 0 then pcall(renderLB) end
        if st.run and frame % 600 == 0 and dinoMyBest() > (X.MG.dinoLB.lastSent or -1) then pcall(dinoLBPush) end
        if st.run then
            frame = frame + 1
            local sp = spNow
            for _, dsh in ipairs(dashes) do
                dsh.x = dsh.x - sp * dt
                if dsh.x < -24 then dsh.x = dsh.x + W + 48 end
                dsh.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(dsh.x + 0.5), dsh.f.Position.Y.Offset)
            end
            st.travel = st.travel + sp * dt
            local old = st.score
            st.score = math.floor(st.travel / 10)
            if st.score > 0 and st.score % 100 == 0 and old ~= st.score then flashUntil = now + 0.6 end
            local wasAir = st.y > 0.5
            if st.y > 0 or st.vy > 0 then
                st.vy = st.vy - (st.duck and 3400 or 1800) * dt
                st.y = st.y + st.vy * dt
                if st.y <= 0 then st.y = 0; st.vy = 0; if wasAir then dust(DX) end end
            end
            if st.travel >= st.nextSpawn then spawn() end
            local ducking = st.duck and st.y <= 0.5
            local dw, dh = ducking and 52 or 44, ducking and 20 or 38
            local dx0, dy0 = DX + 4, GY - st.y - dh - (ducking and 2 or 4)
            for idx = #st.obs, 1, -1 do
                local o = st.obs[idx]
                o.x = o.x - sp * dt
                o.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(o.x + 0.5), GY - o.yb - o.h)
                if o.kind == "bird" then local up = frame % 14 < 7; o.s1.Visible = up; o.s2.Visible = not up end
                if o.x + o.w < -10 then o.f:Destroy(); table.remove(st.obs, idx)
                else
                    local ox0, oy0 = o.x + 2, GY - o.yb - o.h + 2
                    if dx0 < ox0 + o.w - 5 and dx0 + dw > ox0 and dy0 < oy0 + o.h - 5 and dy0 + dh > oy0 then die() end
                end
            end
            if st.run then
                local pose = "run1"
                if st.y > 0.5 then pose = "run1" elseif ducking then pose = "duck1" else pose = (frame % 12 < 6) and "run1" or "run2" end
                show(pose)
                local f = spr[pose]
                f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(DX, GY - st.y - (ducking and 26 or 44))
            end
            if ses then resolve() end
        end
        hud.TextColor3 = (now < flashUntil and (frame % 6 < 3)) and PAL.warn or PAL.dim
        hud.Text = string.format("HI %05d    %05d%s", best, st.score, (ses and oppScore) and ("    opp " .. string.format("%05d", oppScore)) or "")
    end)
    local ctl = {kind = "dino", ses = ses, destroy = function() alive = false; pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end}
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(1.2)
        if alive then pcall(dinoLBPush); pcall(renderLB) end
    end)
    if ses then
        ctl.onNet = function(m)
            if m.t == "p" then oppScore = m.s or oppScore
            elseif m.t == "fin" then oppScore = m.s or 0; oppFin = true
                if not myFin then setStatus("opponent finished with " .. oppScore .. " - beat it!", PAL.warn) end
                resolve()
            elseif m.t == "quit" then oppFin = true; oppScore = -1; setStatus("opponent left - you win", PAL.good) end
        end
        setStatus("same obstacles for both - higher score wins", PAL.dim)
    else setStatus("space / up: jump   down: duck   top right = online top (all roblox)", PAL.dim) end
    return ctl
end

function MG.start(game, diff, ses)
    MG.closeGame()
    gw.Visible = true
    MG.freeze(true)
    local ctl
    if game == "ms" then ctl = MG.minesweeper(diff, ses)
    elseif game == "ttt" then ctl = MG.ttt(diff, ses)
    elseif game == "bs" then ctl = MG.battleship(diff, ses)
    elseif game == "four" then ctl = MG.four(diff, ses)
    else ctl = MG.dino(diff, ses) end
    ctl.kind = ctl.kind or game
    MG.cur = ctl
    MG.base = Vector2.new(gw.Size.X.Offset, gw.Size.Y.Offset)
    gwBody.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(MG.base.X - 20, MG.base.Y - (HEADER + FOOT + 12))
    MG.fit()
    if ses then
        ses.alive = true
        ctl.ses = ses
        startPolling(ses, function(m) if MG.cur == ctl and ctl.onNet then ctl.onNet(m) end end)
    end
end

MG.lobbies = {}
local GNAMES = {ms = "Minesweeper", ttt = "Tic Tac Toe", bs = "Battleship", dino = "Dino Run", four = "4 In A Row"}
function MG.host(game, diff)
    if MG.hosting then MG.hosting.alive = false end
    local id = newId()
    local h = {id = id, alive = true, game = game, diff = diff}
    MG.hosting = h
    local topic = "g" .. id
    MG.setLobbyStatus("hosting " .. GNAMES[game] .. " (" .. DIFFS[diff] .. ") - waiting for a player...", PAL.warn)
    function MG.advertise()
        if os.clock() - (MG.lastAdv or 0) < 2.5 then return end
        MG.lastAdv = os.clock()
        NET.pub(NET.lobby, {t = "adv", id = id, g = game, d = diff})
    end
    MG.advertise()
    task.spawn(function()
        local since = 0
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while h.alive and not MG.dead and not Library.Unloaded and os.clock() - t0 < 600 do
            local list, cur = NET.poll(topic, since); since = cur
            for _, m in ipairs(list) do
                if m.t == "join" and h.alive then
                    h.alive = false; MG.hosting = nil
                    local seed = math.random(1, 2000000000)
                    NET.pub(topic, {t = "start", to = m.n, seed = seed})
                    NET.pub(NET.lobby, {t = "gone", id = id})
                    local ses = {topic = topic, role = "host", opp = m.u, oppNonce = m.n, seed = seed, diff = diff, game = game}
                    MG.setLobbyStatus("")
                    MG.start(game, diff, ses)
                    return
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
        if h.alive then h.alive = false; MG.hosting = nil; NET.pub(NET.lobby, {t = "gone", id = id}); MG.setLobbyStatus("lobby timed out") end
    end)
end
function MG.cancelHost()
    if MG.hosting then NET.pub(NET.lobby, {t = "gone", id = MG.hosting.id}); MG.hosting.alive = false; MG.hosting = nil; MG.setLobbyStatus("hosting cancelled") end
end
function MG.join(lb)
    local topic = "g" .. lb.id
    MG.setLobbyStatus("joining " .. tostring(lb.u) .. "...", PAL.warn)
    NET.pub(topic, {t = "join"})
    task.spawn(function()
        local since, t0 = 0, os.clock()
        while os.clock() - t0 < 25 and not MG.dead do
            local list, cur = NET.poll(topic, since); since = cur
            for _, m in ipairs(list) do
                if m.t == "start" and m.to == NET.nonce then
                    local ses = {topic = topic, role = "guest", opp = lb.u, oppNonce = m.n, seed = m.seed, diff = lb.d, game = lb.g}
                    MG.setLobbyStatus("")
                    MG.start(lb.g, lb.d, ses)
                    return
                end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
        MG.setLobbyStatus("host did not answer (left or busy?)")
    end)
end
function MG.refresh()
    if MG.refreshing then return end
    MG.refreshing = true
    MG.setLobbyStatus("searching this server for script users...", PAL.warn)
    NET.pub(NET.lobby, {t = "who"})
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(3.5)
        MG.refreshing = false
        local map, order = {}, {}
        local nowT = os.time()
        for _, m in ipairs(NET.inbox[NET.lobby] or {}) do
            if m.id and nowT - (m._time or 0) < 40 then
                if m.t == "adv" then map[m.id] = m elseif m.t == "gone" then map[m.id] = false end
            end
        end
        for _, v in pairs(map) do if v and Players:FindFirstChild(v.u) then order[#order + 1] = v end end
        MG.lobbies = order
        if MG.renderLobbies then MG.renderLobbies() end
    end)
end

function MG.waitWindow(game, diff)
    if MG.waitF and MG.waitF.Parent then
        MG.waitW = {game = game, diff = diff, t0 = os.clock()}
        MG.waitGame.Text = GNAMES[game] or "game"
        MG.waitDiff.Text = DIFFS[diff] or ""
        MG.waitF.Visible = true
        return
    end

    local f = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 128), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, -30), BackgroundColor3 = PAL.bg, Visible = false, Active = true, ZIndex = 40, Parent = MG.gui})
    corner(f, 12); stroke(f, ACC[game] or PAL.line, 1.4)
    box(f, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), ACC[game] or PAL.line, nil)
    local ring = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = f})
    corner(ring, 20)
    stroke(ring, (ACC[game] or PAL.text), 2, 0.55)

    local orbit = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = f})
    local dot = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = ACC[game] or PAL.text, Parent = orbit})
    corner(dot, 4)
    txt(f, "waiting", UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 18), UDim2.fromOffset(64, 16), 15, PAL.text, nil, true)
    local gameLbl = txt(f, GNAMES[game] or "game", UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(64, 34), 11, ACC[game] or PAL.dim, nil, true)
    local diffLbl = txt(f, DIFFS[diff] or "", UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 12), UDim2.fromOffset(64, 48), 9, PAL.dim)
    local timeLbl = txt(f, "0s", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 12), UDim2.fromOffset(64, 62), 9, PAL.dim)
    local hint = txt(f, "any server, any player who starts online too joins you", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(14, 84), 8, PAL.dim)
    hint.TextWrapped = true
    hint.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    local cancel = button(f, "cancel", UDim2.fromOffset(74, 22), UDim2.new(1, -84, 1, -30), function()
        if MG.waiting then MG.playOnline(game, diff) end
    end, "danger", nil, 10)
    MG.waitF, MG.waitGame, MG.waitDiff, MG.waitTime, MG.waitCancel = f, gameLbl, diffLbl, timeLbl, cancel
    MakeDraggable(f, f, function() return 1 end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while f.Parent and not MG.dead do
            if f.Visible then
                local now = os.clock()
                pcall(function()
                    orbit.Rotation = (now % 1.4) / 1.4 * 360
                end)
                if MG.waitW then
                    timeLbl.Text = math.floor(now - MG.waitW.t0) .. "s"
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end)
    MG.waitW = {game = game, diff = diff, t0 = os.clock()}
    f.Visible = true

    pcall(function()
        local target = f.Position
        f.Position = UDim2.new(1, 60, target.Y.Scale, target.Y.Offset)
        Tween(f, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = target})
    end)
end
function MG.waitWindowClose()
    if MG.waitF then MG.waitF.Visible = false end
    MG.waitW = nil
end

function MG.playOnline(game, diff)
    if MG.waiting then
        MG.waiting = false
        GNET.lobbyCancel()
        MG.waitWindowClose()
        MG.setLobbyStatus("online search cancelled")
        return
    end
    if not GNET.hasHttp() then
        MG.setLobbyStatus("global online needs an executor with http request - host / find still works in this server", PAL.bad)
        return
    end
    MG.waiting = true
    MG.setLobbyStatus("waiting... (all roblox servers)", PAL.warn)
    MG.waitWindow(game, diff)
    GNET.lobbyRegister(game, diff)
    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while MG.waiting and not MG.dead and not Library.Unloaded and os.clock() - t0 < 300 do
            local ses = GNET.lobbyPoll()
            if ses then
                MG.waiting = false
                MG.waitWindowClose()
                MG.setLobbyStatus("opponent found: " .. tostring(ses.opp) .. " - starting...", PAL.good)
                MG.start(ses.game, ses.diff, ses)
                return
            end
            task.wait(1.3)
        end
        if MG.waiting then
            MG.waiting = false
            GNET.lobbyCancel()
            MG.waitWindowClose()
            MG.setLobbyStatus("nobody joined in 5 minutes - cancelled")
        end
    end)
end

corner(panel, 10); stroke(panel, PAL.line)

grad(pHeadBox, PAL.card2:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.05), PAL.card, 90)
txt(pHeadBox, "Minigames", UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 22), UDim2.fromOffset(14, 5), 15, PAL.text, nil, true)
txt(pHeadBox, "pick a difficulty, then a game", UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(14, 27), 9, PAL.dim)
box(pHeadBox, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1), PAL.line, nil)
local pScroll = New("ScrollingFrame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -58), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = PAL.line, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = panel})

    return New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = pScroll})
end

    local r = row(14)
    txt(r, string.upper(title), UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0), 9, PAL.dim, nil, true)
end

local seg = row(30)
local segBg = box(seg, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), nil, PAL.card, 8); stroke(segBg, PAL.line)
local dBtns, descLbls = {}, {}
local function updateDesc()
    descLbls.ms.Text = "field " .. MSIZE[MG.diff] .. "x" .. MSIZE[MG.diff] .. ", random mine count"
    descLbls.ttt.Text = "3x3 board, bot level " .. MG.diff .. "/4 (4 = unbeatable)"
    descLbls.bs.Text = "10x10 fleet battle, bot level " .. MG.diff .. "/4"
    descLbls.four.Text = "7x6 gravity board, bot level " .. MG.diff .. "/4 (4 = deep think)"
    descLbls.dino.Text = "obstacle speed level " .. MG.diff .. "/4"
end
local function selectDiff(d)
    MG.diff = d
    for i, b in ipairs(dBtns) do
        local on = i == d
        b:SetAttribute("sel", on)
        Tween(b, TWEEN_FAST, {BackgroundColor3 = on and DCOL[i] or PAL.card, TextColor3 = on and PAL.dark or PAL.dim})
    end
    if descLbls.ms then updateDesc() end
end
for i, nm in ipairs(DIFFS) do
    local b = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -4, 1, -6), Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) * 0.25, 3, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = PAL.card, Text = nm, TextSize = 9, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = PAL.dim, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = seg})
    corner(b, 6)
    Connect(b.MouseEnter, function() if not b:GetAttribute("sel") then Tween(b, TWEEN_FAST, {TextColor3 = PAL.text}) end end)
    Connect(b.MouseLeave, function() if not b:GetAttribute("sel") then Tween(b, TWEEN_FAST, {TextColor3 = PAL.dim}) end end)
    Connect(b.MouseButton1Click, function() playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4); selectDiff(i) end)
    dBtns[i] = b
end

section("games")
local function gameCard(key, title, badge, online)
    local c = row(102)
    c.BackgroundTransparency = 0; c.BackgroundColor3 = PAL.card; corner(c, 10); stroke(c, PAL.line)
    local acc = ACC[key]
    box(c, UDim2.fromOffset(3, 34), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 12), acc, 2)
    local bd = box(c, UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10), acc:Lerp(PAL.bg, 0.78), 10); stroke(bd, acc, 1, 0.55)
    txt(bd, badge, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), nil, 12, acc, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
    txt(c, title, UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(58, 9), 12, PAL.text, nil, true)
    local d = txt(c, "", UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(58, 27), 9, PAL.dim)
    d.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

local SLIDE_OUT = TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
function MG.panelPlace()

    local vw = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    pcall(function()
        local v = Cam and Cam.ViewportSize
        if v and v.X then vw = Vector2.new(v.X, v.Y) end
    end)
    local baseY = 140
    local rightX = vw.X > 0 and (vw.X * 0.5 + Win.Main.Size.X.Offset * 0.5 + 10) or 480
    pcall(function()
        local ap, asz = Win.Root.AbsolutePosition, Win.Root.AbsoluteSize
        rightX = ap.X + asz.X + 8
        baseY = math.clamp(ap.Y + asz.Y * 0.5 - panel.Size.Y.Offset * 0.5, 6, math.max(vw.Y - panel.Size.Y.Offset - 6, 6))
        if vw.X > 0 and rightX + panel.Size.X.Offset > vw.X - 6 then
            rightX = math.max(ap.X - panel.Size.X.Offset - 8, 6)
        end
    end)
    return rightX, baseY
end
function MG.setOpen(v)
    if MG.open == v then return end
    MG.open = v
    if v then
        local rightX, baseY = MG.panelPlace()
        panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rightX + 70, baseY)
        panel.Visible = true
        Tween(panel, SLIDE_IN, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rightX, baseY)})
    else
        local x = panel.Position.X.Offset
        local y = panel.Position.Y.Offset
        Tween(panel, SLIDE_OUT, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 90, y)})
        task.delay(0.36, function() if not MG.open then panel.Visible = false end end)
    end
end

    local y1 = math.min(pa.Y + pas.Y, wa.Y + was.Y)
    local x0 = math.max(pa.X, wa.X)
    local x1 = math.min(pa.X + pas.X, wa.X + was.X)

                linkLine.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(wR + 1, yMid)
                linkLine.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(gap - 2, 2), 2)
                linkLine.Visible = true
            else
                linkLine.Visible = false
            end

            local gap = wL - myR
            if gap > 2 then
                linkLine.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(myR + 1, yMid)
                linkLine.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(gap - 2, 2), 2)
                linkLine.Visible = true
            else
                linkLine.Visible = false
            end
        else
            linkLine.Visible = false
        end
    else
        linkLine.Visible = false
    end

    local myB, myT = pa.Y + pas.Y, pa.Y
    local wB, wT = wa.Y + was.Y, wa.Y
    if x1 - x0 > 8 and y1 - y0 <= 8 then
        local xMid = (x0 + x1) / 2
        if myT >= wB - 2 then
            local gap = myT - wB
            if gap > 2 then
                linkLineV.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(xMid, wB + 1)
                linkLineV.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, math.max(gap - 2, 2))
                linkLineV.Visible = true
            else
                linkLineV.Visible = false
            end

                linkLineV.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, math.max(gap - 2, 2))
                linkLineV.Visible = true
            else
                linkLineV.Visible = false
            end
        else

        end

    end
end)

local function findToggle(name)
    for _, tab in ipairs(Win.Tabs) do
        for _, sec in ipairs(tab.Sections) do
            for _, el in ipairs(sec.Elements) do
                if el.Type == "Toggle" and el.Name == name then return el end
            end
        end
    end
end
local function parseKey(s)
    s = tostring(s or ""):gsub("%s", "")
    if s == "" then return nil end

    local alias = {
        space = "Space", lshift = "LeftShift", rshift = "RightShift", shift = "LeftShift",
        lctrl = "LeftControl", rctrl = "RightControl", ctrl = "LeftControl", lalt = "LeftAlt",
        ralt = "RightAlt", alt = "LeftAlt", enter = "Return", esc = "Escape",
        leftshift = "LeftShift", rightshift = "RightShift", leftctrl = "LeftControl",
        rightctrl = "RightControl", leftalt = "LeftAlt", rightalt = "RightAlt",
        up = "Up", down = "Down", left = "Left", right = "Right", ins = "Insert",
        del = "Delete", pageup = "PageUp", pagedown = "PageDown", caps = "CapsLock",
        capslock = "CapsLock", grave = "Backquote", tick = "Backquote", backspace = "Backspace",
    }
    local key = alias[string.lower(s)] or s

    local cands = { key, string.upper(key), key:sub(1, 1):upper() .. key:sub(2):lower() }
    for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
        local ok, kc = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[c] end)
        if ok and kc then return kc end
    end
    return nil
end

local function fmtMsg(e)
    local nm = tostring(e.d and e.d ~= "" and e.d or e.n or "?")
    if #nm > 14 then nm = string.sub(nm, 1, 14) .. ".." end
    local mins = math.floor((os.time() - (tonumber(e.t) or os.time())) / 60)
    if mins < 0 then mins = 0 end
    local tag = "now"
    if mins >= 60 then tag = math.floor(mins / 60) .. "h"
    elseif mins >= 1 then tag = mins .. "m" end
    return "[" .. tag .. "] " .. nm .. ": " .. tostring(e.m or "")
end
local function ensureRows(view, n)
    while #view.rowT < n do
        local l = New("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 10, Font = Theme.Font, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextWrapped = true, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = view.list})
        view.rowT[#view.rowT + 1] = l
    end
end
local function renderView(view)
    local n = math.min(#CH.items, view.cap)
    ensureRows(view, n)
    local first = #CH.items - n + 1
    for i = 1, n do
        local e = CH.items[first + i - 1]
        local l = view.rowT[i]
        l.Text = fmtMsg(e)
        l.TextColor3 = (e.n == meName) and Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 150) or Theme.Text
        l.Visible = true
    end
    for i = n + 1, #view.rowT do view.rowT[i].Visible = false end
    task.defer(function()
        if not view.list.Parent then return end
        pcall(function()
            local ll = view.list:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
            local h = ll and ll.AbsoluteContentSize.Y or 0
            if h > 0 then
                view.list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, h + 6)
                if h > view.list.AbsoluteSize.Y then view.list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, h) end
            end
        end)
    end)
end
local function registerView(list, cap)
    local view = {list = list, rowT = {}, cap = cap or 40}
    views[#views + 1] = view
    return view
end

-- auto clear: any message older than CH.MAX_AGE (30 minutes) drops out of the list
function CH.prune()
    local now = os.time()
    local out, changed = {}, false
    for _, e in ipairs(CH.items) do
        if (now - (tonumber(e.t) or 0)) <= CH.MAX_AGE then out[#out + 1] = e else changed = true end
    end
    if changed then CH.items = out end
    return changed
end

function CH.render()
    CH.prune()
    for _, v in ipairs(views) do renderView(v) end
end

function CH.fetch()
    if not (GNET and GNET.hasHttp and GNET.hasHttp()) then return end
    local ok, d = pcall(GNET.pull, true)
    if not ok or type(d) ~= "table" or type(d.chat) ~= "table" then return end
    local arr = {}
    local now = os.time()
    for _, e in pairs(d.chat) do
        if type(e) == "table" and e.m then
            local t = tonumber(e.t) or 0
            if (now - t) <= CH.MAX_AGE then arr[#arr + 1] = {n = tostring(e.n or "?"), d = tostring(e.d or ""), m = tostring(e.m), t = t} end
        end
    end
    table.sort(arr, function(a, b) return (a.t or 0) < (b.t or 0) end)
    while #arr > 60 do table.remove(arr, 1) end
    CH.items = arr
    CH.render()
end

function CH.send(txt)
    txt = tostring(txt or ""):gsub("[%c]", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if txt == "" then return end
    if #txt > 130 then txt = string.sub(txt, 1, 130) end
    if not (GNET and GNET.hasHttp and GNET.hasHttp()) then
        Library:Notify({Title = "chat", Text = "no http in your executor - global chat unavailable", Duration = 3})
        return
    end
    if os.clock() < CH.lastSent + 1.2 then
        Library:Notify({Title = "chat", Text = "too fast - wait a moment", Duration = 2})
        return
    end
    CH.lastSent = os.clock()
    local disp = LocalPlayer.DisplayName
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(GNET.commit, function(d)
            d.chat = type(d.chat) == "table" and d.chat or {}
            table.insert(d.chat, {n = meName, d = disp, m = txt, t = os.time()})
            -- keep the shared room clean: drop everything older than 30 minutes
            local arr = {}
            local now = os.time()
            for _, e in pairs(d.chat) do
                if type(e) == "table" and e.m then
                    local t = tonumber(e.t) or 0
                    if (now - t) <= CH.MAX_AGE then arr[#arr + 1] = {n = e.n, d = e.d, m = tostring(e.m), t = t} end
                end
            end
            table.sort(arr, function(a, b) return (a.t or 0) < (b.t or 0) end)
            while #arr > 60 do table.remove(arr, 1) end
            d.chat = arr
        end)
        CH.fetch()
    end)
end

    if v then

        cf.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, 70)

    end
end

X.wallpaperFromInput = function(v)
    v = tostring(v or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if v == "" then return "" end
    if v:find("^https?://") then
        -- cached import first: no http when the picture was saved before
        if type(writefile) == "function" and type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
            for _, ext in ipairs({".png", ".jpg"}) do
                local fn = "piddle_custom_bg" .. ext
                local okF, has = pcall(function() return isfile and isfile(fn) end)
                if okF and has then
                    local okC, c = pcall(getcustomasset, fn)
                    if okC and type(c) == "string" and c:find("^rbxasset") then return c end
                end
            end
        end
        local ok, img = pcall(function()
            local data
            if type(HttpGet) == "function" then data = HttpGet(v) elseif type(game.HttpGet) == "function" then data = game:HttpGet(v) end
            if type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 64 then return nil end
            local ext = ".png"
            if data:sub(1, 3) == "\255\216\255" then ext = ".jpg"
            elseif data:sub(1, 4) ~= "\137PNG" then return nil end
            if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return nil end
            writefile("piddle_custom_bg" .. ext, data)
            local c = getcustomasset("piddle_custom_bg" .. ext)
            if type(c) == "string" and c:find("^rbxasset") then return c end
            return nil
        end)
        return (ok and img) or ""
    end
    return ResolveImage(v)
end
-- named styles that come from a url: download once into a per-style cache file
-- (each style keeps its own file so they never overwrite each other) and reuse it
function X.styleWallpaper(name, url)
    url = tostring(url or "")
    if not url:find("^https?://") then return "" end
    local key = (tostring(name or "style"):lower():gsub("[^%w]", ""))
    -- cached file first: on the next runs no http is needed at all (also avoids
    -- freezing on blocked hosts), each style keeps its own file with the right ext
    if type(writefile) == "function" and type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
        for _, ext in ipairs({".png", ".jpg"}) do
            local fn = "piddle_bg_" .. key .. ext
            local okF, has = pcall(function() return isfile and isfile(fn) end)
            if okF and has then
                local okC, c = pcall(getcustomasset, fn)
                if okC and type(c) == "string" and c:find("^rbxasset") then return c end
            end
        end
    end
    local ok, img = pcall(function()
        local data
        if type(HttpGet) == "function" then data = HttpGet(url) elseif type(game.HttpGet) == "function" then data = game:HttpGet(url) end
        if type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 64 then return nil end
        local ext = ".png"
        if data:sub(1, 3) == "\255\216\255" then ext = ".jpg"
        elseif data:sub(1, 4) ~= "\137PNG" then return nil end
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local fname = "piddle_bg_" .. key .. ext
        writefile(fname, data)
        local c = getcustomasset(fname)
        if type(c) == "string" and c:find("^rbxasset") then return c end
        return nil
    end)
    if ok and img then return img end
    pcall(function() Library:Notify({Title = "background", Text = tostring(name) .. " failed to load - check internet / executor http", Duration = 4}) end)
    return ""
end

X.UI = {pend=nil, busy=false}
function X.UI.remap(list, kind)
    local gui = Library.Gui
    if not gui then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
            local c = d.BackgroundColor3
            for _, pr in ipairs(list) do
                if c == pr[1] then d.BackgroundColor3 = pr[2]; break end
            end
            if kind ~= "line" then
                if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
                    local t = d.TextColor3
                    for _, pr in ipairs(list) do
                        if t == pr[1] then d.TextColor3 = pr[2]; break end
                    end
                elseif d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                    local t = d.ScrollBarImageColor3
                    for _, pr in ipairs(list) do
                        if t == pr[1] then d.ScrollBarImageColor3 = pr[2]; break end
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
            local tagged = d:GetAttribute("L")
            local c = d.Color
            for _, pr in ipairs(list) do
                if c == pr[1] then
                    if kind == "line" and not tagged then break end
                    if kind == "accent" and tagged and Theme.Accent == Theme.Stroke then break end
                    d.Color = pr[2]; break
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
function X.UI.setAccent(c)
    local old = Theme.Accent
    if old == c then return end
    X.UI.remap({{old, c}}, "accent")
    Theme.Accent = c
end
function X.UI.setLine(c)
    local oldS, oldSoft = Theme.Stroke, Theme.StrokeSoft
    local newSoft = c:Lerp(Theme.Window, 0.45)
    if oldS == c then return end
    X.UI.remap({{oldS, c}, {oldSoft, newSoft}}, "line")
    Theme.Stroke = c
    Theme.StrokeSoft = newSoft
end
function X.UI.queue(kind, c)
    X.UI.pend = X.UI.pend or {}
    X.UI.pend[kind] = c
    if X.UI.busy then return end
    X.UI.busy = true
    task.delay(0.15, function()
        X.UI.busy = false
        local p = X.UI.pend
        X.UI.pend = nil
        if not p then return end
        if p.accent then pcall(X.UI.setAccent, p.accent) end
        if p.line then pcall(X.UI.setLine, p.line) end
    end)
end

function X.round(d)
    local c = d.ClassName
    if c ~= "Frame" and c ~= "TextButton" and c ~= "ImageLabel" and c ~= "ImageButton" and c ~= "TextBox" and c ~= "ScrollingFrame" then return end
    if d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then return end
    local solid = d.BackgroundTransparency < 0.95
    local img = (c == "ImageLabel" or c == "ImageButton") and d.Image ~= ""
    if not solid and not img then return end
    local sx, sy = d.Size.X, d.Size.Y
    local mn = math.huge
    if sx.Scale == 0 then mn = math.min(mn, sx.Offset) end
    if sy.Scale == 0 then mn = math.min(mn, sy.Offset) end
    if mn <= 3 then return end
    local r = 5
    if mn ~= math.huge and mn < 16 then r = math.max(2, math.floor(mn / 2)) end
    if sx.Scale == 1 and sy.Scale == 1 then r = 8 end
    if d.Name == "BgImage" or d.Name == "Main" then r = 8 end
    Corner(d, r)
end

            X.rq = {}

                if o.Parent then pcall(X.round, o) end
            end
        end)
    end)
end

    pcall(function() X.NC.restore() end)
    pcall(X.WINGS.destroy); pcall(X.AURA.destroy); pcall(X.AL.disable)
    pcall(function() X.LW.remove() end); pcall(function() X.ANIM.destroy() end)
    pcall(function() if X.HIT and X.HIT.clear then X.HIT.clear() end end)
    pcall(function()
        if UD and UD.showParts then
            for _, p in ipairs(UD.showParts) do pcall(function() p:Destroy() end) end
            UD.showParts = nil
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        for _, nm in ipairs({"PiddleWarn", "PiddleMiniPlayer", "PiddleAutoCalc"}) do
            for _, par in ipairs({WS, game:GetService("CoreGui"), LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")}) do
                if par then local g = par:FindFirstChild(nm); if g then g:Destroy() end end
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function() X.PV.clear() end); pcall(function() X.BoxESP.destroyAll() end); pcall(function() X.NOIR.destroy() end)
    pcall(function() if X.ESPF then X.ESPF:Destroy() end end)
    pcall(function() if X.FP and X.FP.on then X.FP.stop() end end)
    X.LT = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        pcall(function() destroySkeleton(p) end)
        pcall(function() if tracers[p] then tracers[p].Visible = false; tracers[p]:Remove(); tracers[p] = nil end end)
        pcall(function()
            local c = p.Character
            if c then
                local h = c:FindFirstChild("PiddleHighlight"); if h then h:Destroy() end
                local t = c:FindFirstChild("PiddleTag"); if t then t:Destroy() end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

end)
if not __ok then warn("[piddle] module 'unload' failed: "..tostring(__err)); pcall(function() Library:Notify({Title="piddle",Text="module 'unload' failed: "..tostring(__err),Duration=10}) end) end end
do local b=BG_LIST[CFG.bgName]
    if CFG.bgName=="Custom" then task.delay(0.2, function() pcall(function()
        local img=X.wallpaperFromInput(CFG.customWallpaper or "")
        if img~="" then
            if Win.BgImage then Win.BgImage.Image=img end
            if wmBg then wmBg.Image=img end
        end
    end) end)
    elseif type(b)=="string" and b:find("^https?://") then task.delay(0.2, function() pcall(function()
        local img=X.styleWallpaper(CFG.bgName, b)
        if img~="" then
            if Win.BgImage then Win.BgImage.Image=img end
            if wmBg then wmBg.Image=img end
        end
    end) end)
    elseif type(b)=="string" and b:find("^video:") then task.delay(1, function() pcall(X.LW.apply, true) end)
    elseif type(b)=="string" and b:find("^anim:") then task.delay(0.5, function() pcall(X.ANIM.apply, true, b:sub(6)) end) end
end
